[vc_row][vc_column][vc_column_text css=””]

Dogs can’t enter the Theme Park, except for registered assistance dogs.

If you’re visiting with your dog, we have a small number of kennels available near the entrance. These are first-come, first-served and can’t be reserved in advance.

Kennels are unsupervised, so owners are responsible for their dog’s comfort and welfare while using them.

To use a kennel, please visit the entrance kiosk on arrival. A £25 refundable deposit is required for the padlock and will be returned when it’s handed back.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row]

[vc_row]

[vc_single_image image=”12051″ img_size=”full” alignment=”center” style=”vc_box_rounded”]
[/vc_column]

[vc_column width=”1/2″][vc_column_text]

Please bring a water bowl and bedding (such as a blanket or bed) so your dog can settle comfortably. A water tap is available at the kennel area.

Kennel size:

220 cm deep
122 cm wide
118 cm high

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column]

[/vc_row]

title: Family Campsite in Devon
excerptHtml: [vc_row][vc_column width=”2/3″][vc_custom_heading text=”Woodlands Caravan & Camping” font_container=”tag:h2|text_align:left|color:%23ffffff” use_theme_fonts=”yes” css=”.vc_custom_1713958296442{margin-bottom: -10px !important;}”][vc_custom_heading text=”Plan your 2026 summer holiday in Devon!” font_container=”tag:h3|text_align:left|color:%23facc21″ use_theme_fonts=”yes” css=”.vc_custom_1768398369731{margin-top: 15px !important;margin-bottom: -10px !important;}”][vc_column_text css=””]There’s no better destination for […]
excerptText: [vc_row][vc_column width="2/3″][vc_custom_heading text="Woodlands Caravan & Camping" font_container="tag:h2|text_align:left|color:%23ffffff" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1713958296442{margin-bottom: -10px !important;}"][vc_custom_heading text="Plan your 2026 summer holiday in Devon!" font_container="tag:h3|text_align:left|color:%23facc21″ use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1768398369731{margin-top: 15px !important;margin-bottom: -10px !important;}"][vc_column_text css=""]There’s no better destination for [...]
contentHtml:
[vc_row][vc_column width=”2/3″][vc_custom_heading text=”Woodlands Caravan & Camping” font_container=”tag:h2|text_align:left|color:%23ffffff” use_theme_fonts=”yes” css=”.vc_custom_1713958296442{margin-bottom: -10px !important;}”][vc_custom_heading text=”Plan your 2026 summer holiday in Devon!” font_container=”tag:h3|text_align:left|color:%23facc21″ use_theme_fonts=”yes” css=”.vc_custom_1768398369731{margin-top: 15px !important;margin-bottom: -10px !important;}”][vc_column_text css=””]There’s no better destination for a fun-filled family holiday! Our award-winning family campsite is an amazing holiday location, with theme park access for guests and historic towns & beaches only a short journey away.

Pitch up with your tent, motorhome, or caravan on one of our spacious pitches. With formal all-weather and grass electric pitches available as well as informal ‘wild’ style camping pitches amongst the trees, we’ve got something suitable for all kinds of campers!

Onsite guests can enjoy access to our facilities buildings, games room, general store, cycle trail, dog walking area, falconry centre, takeaway, zoo farm and Woodlands Family Theme Park.[/vc_column_text][vc_custom_heading text=”Camping in Devon” font_container=”tag:h2|text_align:left|color:%23ffffff” use_theme_fonts=”yes” css=”.vc_custom_1484216524237{margin-bottom: -10px !important;}”][vc_column_text css=””]The beautiful Devonshire surroundings and wildlife makes a perfect holiday location! Only a short drive from Dartmouth, surrounded by great beaches, the fantastic scenery of Dartmoor, and the city life of Exeter & Plymouth nearby, where better to go camping in Devon with your family?

Plus, everyone staying at the site gets completely free entry to Woodlands Theme Park for the duration of their stay! *With stays of 2 nights or more.[/vc_column_text][vc_custom_heading text=”Glamping in Devon” font_container=”tag:h2|text_align:left|color:%23ffffff” use_theme_fonts=”yes” css=”.vc_custom_1770123946803{margin-bottom: -10px !important;}”][vc_column_text css=””]

Looking for a little extra comfort while still enjoying the great outdoors? Our brand new glamping pods are the perfect mix of home comforts and camping fun, ideal for families or groups of up to six people.

Each pod comes fully equipped with a double bed, two fold-out double sofa beds, dining table and benches, plus handy extras including a microwave, toaster, kettle, mini fridge, TV, small heater and electric socket for charging devices. You’ll also have your own parking space right next to the pod, making unloading nice and easy.

And just like all our guests, glamping pod stays of 2 nights or more include completely free entry to Woodlands Theme Park for the duration of your stay – the perfect bonus for a fun-filled family holiday.

[/vc_column_text][vc_custom_heading text=”Other Family Activities in Devon” font_container=”tag:h2|text_align:left|color:%23ffffff” use_theme_fonts=”yes” css=”.vc_custom_1559139325212{margin-bottom: -10px !important;}”][vc_column_text css=””]If you’re looking to travel further afield during your stay why not visit…

  • Dartmouth (10 minute drive) – set on the western bank of the estuary of the River Dart. With award-winning waterside eateries and Dartmouth Castle.
  • Hire Kayaks and explore Devon’s stunning coastline from the water.
  • Totnes (20 minute drive) – visit the Totnes Market, feast on a delicious lunch and take in the historic architecture.
  • Visit Blackpool Sands (15 minute drive) – a stunning Blue Flag beach only a short drive from our site.
  • Enjoy a 14 mile round trip by steam train through the Devon countryside on a South Devon Railway tour.

Visit www.devonstopattractions.co.uk to find out more about what you can get up to during your stay in Devon![/vc_column_text][/vc_column][vc_column width=”1/3″][vc_single_image image=”8327″ img_size=”medium” alignment=”center”][vc_custom_heading text=”Search Availability at Woodlands Caravan & Camping” font_container=”tag:h2|text_align:center” use_theme_fonts=”yes”][vc_separator]

   The date should be in day/month/year format
[/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][vc_tta_accordion active_section=”4″ collapsible_all=”true”][vc_tta_section title=”Tent Pitches” tab_id=”1484149825865-2beb7374-fc91″][vc_column_text css=””]

Make your next camping holiday a Woodlands staycation! We have terraced pitches and informal pitches available for tent camping. Please visit our camping website to book online or call 01803 712 598 to speak to one of our team.

From only £38.50 per night

Use of 10 AMP Electric Hook-up Box: £14.50 per night

Small Pup Tent (smaller than 180cm x 105cm): £8.00 per night

Gazebo or Awning: £10.00 per night (each)

Dogs: £10 per night

Extra car: £10.00

Trailer or Boat: £6.00 (each)

[/vc_column_text][vc_btn title=”Book Now” color=”warning” size=”lg” align=”center” css=”” link=”url:https%3A%2F%2Fwww.woodlandsgrove.co.uk%2Ftariffs-booking%2F”][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”Motorhomes, Caravans & Camper Vans” tab_id=”1484149825885-e519a8fd-f423″][vc_column_text css=””]

At Woodlands you’ll find pitches suitable for motorhomes, caravans and camper vans of most sizes. A range of all-weather and informal grass pitches are available on site, with space for gazebos, awnings or any other extras you may be bringing. Please visit our camping website to book online or call 01803 712 598 to speak to one of our team!

Our award-winning family campsite is an amazing holiday location, with theme park access for guests and historic towns & beaches only a short journey away.

 Pitch up with your tent, motorhome, or caravan on one of our spacious pitches. With formal all-weather and grass electric pitches available as well as informal ‘wild’ style camping pitches amongst the trees, we’ve got something suitable for all kinds of campers!

 Onsite guests can enjoy access to our facilities buildings, games room, general store, cycle trail, dog walking area, falconry centre, takeaway, zoo farm and Woodlands Family Theme Park.[/vc_column_text][vc_custom_heading text="Camping in Devon" font_container="tag:h2|text_align:left|color:%23ffffff" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1484216524237{margin-bottom: -10px !important;}"][vc_column_text css=""]The beautiful Devonshire surroundings and wildlife makes a perfect holiday location! Only a short drive from Dartmouth, surrounded by great beaches, the fantastic scenery of Dartmoor, and the city life of Exeter & Plymouth nearby, where better to go camping in Devon with your family?

 Plus, everyone staying at the site gets completely free entry to Woodlands Theme Park for the duration of their stay! *With stays of 2 nights or more.[/vc_column_text][vc_custom_heading text="Glamping in Devon" font_container="tag:h2|text_align:left|color:%23ffffff" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1770123946803{margin-bottom: -10px !important;}"][vc_column_text css=""]

 Looking for a little extra comfort while still enjoying the great outdoors? Our brand new glamping pods are the perfect mix of home comforts and camping fun, ideal for families or groups of up to six people .

 Each pod comes fully equipped with a double bed , two fold-out double sofa beds , dining table and benches, plus handy extras including a microwave, toaster, kettle, mini fridge, TV, small heater and electric socket for charging devices. You’ll also have your own parking space right next to the pod , making unloading nice and easy.

 And just like all our guests, glamping pod stays of 2 nights or more include completely free entry to Woodlands Theme Park for the duration of your stay – the perfect bonus for a fun-filled family holiday.

 Dartmouth (10 minute drive) – set on the western bank of the estuary of the River Dart. With award-winning waterside eateries and Dartmouth Castle.

 Hire Kayaks and explore Devon’s stunning coastline from the water.

 Totnes (20 minute drive) – visit the Totnes Market, feast on a delicious lunch and take in the historic architecture.

 Visit Blackpool Sands (15 minute drive) – a stunning Blue Flag beach only a short drive from our site.

 Enjoy a 14 mile round trip by steam train through the Devon countryside on a South Devon Railway tour.

 Visit www.devonstopattractions.co.uk to find out more about what you can get up to during your stay in Devon![/vc_column_text][/vc_column][vc_column width="1/3″][vc_single_image image="8327″ img_size="medium" alignment="center"][vc_custom_heading text="Search Availability at Woodlands Caravan & Camping" font_container="tag:h2|text_align:center" use_theme_fonts="yes"][vc_separator]

May Half Term Opening Dates – Open everyday 25th – 29th May 2020.

If you’re looking for something fun to do with the kids during half term and bank holiday weekends, look no further than our park events! With fantastic activities running throughout the year no matter whether it’s sunny or rainy, you’re sure to enjoy yourself.

Action-packed Family Fun

2025 is going to be full of exciting events at Woodlands Family Theme Park including an awesome selection of special guests you may recognise from TV! Our theme park is ready to make your family days out in Devon exciting, energetic and fun! Visit the events page to see more of what’s coming up.

Character Events are always free with theme park tickets. Save BIG when you buy online with 30% off on tickets purchased before the day of entry!

As well as Character Events the park will also host its seasonally themed grottos, including the magical fan favourite Christmas Grotto. Information on Grottos will be released prior to their openings on the events page.

Animal lovers will adore meeting a variety of our zoo farm animals at our meet & greet and feeding sessions. Stars include our rabbits, guinea pigs, reptiles, and meerkats! Animal activity sessions are on most weekends and school holidays.

 

Visiting Our Family Fun Theme Park in Devon

We can’t wait to welcome you to your family day out in Devon, from our exciting ride Vertigo to the quiet reptile house, we’ve got 90 acres of family fun waiting for you at our theme park! Please click here for opening times.

From 2 to 92 there’s tons for all the family to do at Woodlands. From a sedate walk around the enchanted forest to exploring our 125,000 square foot of indoor fun. You can take your day out at your own pace. We also welcome groups, from language schools to corporate events and school trips. Get more information about group bookings here.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][vc_separator][vc_column_text css=”.vc_custom_1676897513322{border-top-width: 4px !important;border-right-width: 4px !important;border-bottom-width: 4px !important;border-left-width: 4px !important;padding-top: 10px !important;padding-right: 20px !important;padding-bottom: 20px !important;padding-left: 20px !important;background-color: #73073b !important;border-left-color: #facc21 !important;border-left-style: solid !important;border-right-color: #facc21 !important;border-right-style: solid !important;border-top-color: #facc21 !important;border-top-style: solid !important;border-bottom-color: #facc21 !important;border-bottom-style: solid !important;}”]

Want to stay with us?

Come on your family holiday and go camping in Devon at Woodlands Caravan & Camping Park! Visit our camping website here.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][vc_column_text css=”.vc_custom_1556712613016{border-top-width: 4px !important;border-right-width: 4px !important;border-bottom-width: 4px !important;border-left-width: 4px !important;padding-top: 10px !important;padding-right: 20px !important;padding-bottom: 20px !important;padding-left: 20px !important;background-color: #73073b !important;border-left-color: #facc21 !important;border-left-style: solid !important;border-right-color: #facc21 !important;border-right-style: solid !important;border-top-color: #facc21 !important;border-top-style: solid !important;border-bottom-color: #facc21 !important;border-bottom-style: solid !important;}”]

Visit the Zoo!

Entry to the zoo farm is included in your ticket price.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][vc_column_text css=”.vc_custom_1713782340660{border-top-width: 4px !important;border-right-width: 4px !important;border-bottom-width: 4px !important;border-left-width: 4px !important;padding-top: 10px !important;padding-right: 20px !important;padding-bottom: 20px !important;padding-left: 20px !important;background-color: #73073b !important;border-left-color: #facc21 !important;border-left-style: solid !important;border-right-color: #facc21 !important;border-right-style: solid !important;border-top-color: #facc21 !important;border-top-style: solid !important;border-bottom-color: #facc21 !important;border-bottom-style: solid !important;}”]

We also have various offers and events running all through the year! Events such as your favourite character paying us a visit, come and play at Woodlands and enjoy your day out with the kids in Devon![/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=”.vc_custom_1719411898868{border-top-width: 4px !important;border-right-width: 4px !important;border-bottom-width: 4px !important;border-left-width: 4px !important;padding-top: 10px !important;padding-right: 20px !important;padding-bottom: 20px !important;padding-left: 20px !important;background-color: #73073b !important;border-left-color: #facc21 !important;border-left-style: solid !important;border-right-color: #facc21 !important;border-right-style: solid !important;border-top-color: #facc21 !important;border-top-style: solid !important;border-bottom-color: #facc21 !important;border-bottom-style: solid !important;}”]

 Character Events are always free with theme park tickets. Save BIG when you buy online with 30% off on tickets purchased before the day of entry!

 As well as Character Events the park will also host its seasonally themed grottos, including the magical fan favourite Christmas Grotto. Information on Grottos will be released prior to their openings on the events page.

 Animal lovers will adore meeting a variety of our zoo farm animals at our meet & greet and feeding sessions. Stars include our rabbits, guinea pigs, reptiles, and meerkats! Animal activity sessions are on most weekends and school holidays.

 Visiting Our Family Fun Theme Park in Devon

 We can’t wait to welcome you to your family day out in Devon, from our exciting ride Vertigo to the quiet reptile house , we’ve got 90 acres of family fun waiting for you at our theme park! Please click here for opening times .

 From 2 to 92 there’s tons for all the family to do at Woodlands. From a sedate walk around the enchanted forest to exploring our 125,000 square foot of indoor fun. You can take your day out at your own pace. We also welcome groups, from language schools to corporate events and school trips. Get more information about group bookings here. title: Halloween at Woodlands
headings: Ride in the Woodlands Ghost Farm!
excerptHtml: [vc_row][vc_column][vc_column_text] Halloween Events 2019 at Woodlands! Our Halloween events for 2019 are going to be bigger, better, and spookier than ever, so keep an eye on this page and our […]
excerptText: [vc_row][vc_column][vc_column_text] Halloween Events 2019 at Woodlands! Our Halloween events for 2019 are going to be bigger, better, and spookier than ever, so keep an eye on this page and our [...]
contentHtml:
[vc_row][vc_column][vc_column_text]

Halloween Events 2019 at Woodlands!

Our Halloween events for 2019 are going to be bigger, better, and spookier than ever, so keep an eye on this page and our Facebook page to be the first to hear about the best Halloween events in Devon for 2019! Kids and adults alike will enjoy the frighteningly good time we’ve got planned at Woodlands this year, there’s so many activities you’re spoilt for things to do in October half-term.

Check out some of our  Halloween events below – check the individual events for details. With all of the Halloween activities for families and the incredible rides and attractions, Woodlands Family Theme Park is the place to be this October half-term.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][vc_empty_space height=”18px”][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row css=”.vc_custom_1537180678250{border-radius: 2px !important;}”][vc_column css=”.vc_custom_1537196596736{background-color: #8a0a49 !important;}”][vc_single_image image=”6951″ img_size=”full”][vc_column_text]

Marty’s Monster Manor

Marty the friendly monster returned to his monster manor this Halloween! Come and meet Marty the friendly monster in Marty’s Monster Manor and experience mysterious surprises around every eerie corner.

He’ll send you through spooky rooms and past the ghoulish ghosts to find him at the end, along with a treat![/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][vc_empty_space height=”18px”][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column css=”.vc_custom_1537196752129{background-color: #8a0a49 !important;}”][vc_single_image image=”6958″ img_size=”full”][vc_column_text]

Pumpkin Carving

We had some great pumpkins last year, we were super impressed (and spooked) by the scary pumpkins you carved at the park, we’re looking forward to what you create for us this year! If you share your creepy creations on Facebook make sure you tag @WoodlandsFamilyThemePark or @Woodlands_Park if you’re on Twitter so we can share your artwork!

We’ll have even more pumpkins this year so be sure to get one whilst they last and carve the spookiest design you can think of![/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][vc_empty_space height=”18px”][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column css=”.vc_custom_1464959326825{padding-top: 18px !important;background-color: #8a0a49 !important;}”][vc_single_image image=”6942″ img_size=”full”][vc_column_text]

Wicked Witch of Woodlands 

Ezmerelda the wicked witch of Woodlands is back with different spooky activities for you to take part in! She’s only here from Monday 21st to Friday 25th October & Monday 28th October to Friday 1st November 2019 as she’s a very busy witch, with lots of spooktacular places to go and creeps to see!

When admission paying children over 92cm join in 2 of Ezmeralda’s activities they will also get a free child return winter ticket.
Infants under 92cm are welcome to join in the activities for the spooky fun.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][vc_empty_space height=”18px”][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column css=”.vc_custom_1464959326825{padding-top: 18px !important;background-color: #8a0a49 !important;}”][vc_single_image image=”6947″ img_size=”full”][vc_column_text]

Ride in the Woodlands Ghost Farm!

Ride the tractors of the Woodlands Halloween Ghost Farm and hear the spine-tingling ghosts whizzing past you as you drive around the deserted farm! Beware of the ghostly surprises along the way and try not to get too spooked.

Join in a sing along with the singing pumpkins, this ride will be available all day from 19th October – 3rd November so it’s easy to plan into your day when you visit the best Halloween event in Devon![/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][vc_empty_space height=”18px”][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column css=”.vc_custom_1474888850147{background-color: #8a0a49 !important;}”][vc_column_text]

How to find us?

[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text]For more information about how to get here visit our Contact & Find Us page.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row]

A full list of attraction height and age restrictions is available below.

Children under 17 years old must be supervised by an adult at all times.

[/vc_column_text][vc_tta_accordion active_section=”1″ collapsible_all=”true”][vc_tta_section title=”No Minimum Height” tab_id=”1731922924655-693df026-328b”][vc_column_text css=””]DinoTrek, Seascape Mirror Maze, Safari Adventure Golf, Action Track 1 – Supervised.

Zip Slides, Paddling Pool, Christmas Train – Accompanied.

Farmyard Ride – Riders under 110cm must be accompanied.

No Minimum Height (Max height/age applies):

Toddler Ice Palace – Max 95cm (accompanied. No shoes).

Junior Ice Palace – Max 125cm (accompanied. No shoes).

Pedal Town, Dolphin Toddler Play, Toddler Play Village – Max 110cm.

Mermaids Ball Pool, Big Top Soft Play – Max 110cm (accompanied. No shoes).

Mini Ninja Playtime – Under 5s only.

Golden Bear City – Max 110cm.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”Minimum Height 80cm” tab_id=”1731922964413-c7fd91a3-3feb”][vc_column_text css=””]Submarine Ride, Polar Pilot – 80cm to 140cm.

Dragon’s Ferris Wheel – 80cm to 140cm. Accompanied Max 140cm.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”Minimum Height 90-96cm” tab_id=”1731922969461-8a6a9387-276b”][vc_column_text css=””]Jumping Pillow – 90cm to 120cm accompanied. 120cm+ unaccompanied.

Watercoasters – Riders 90cm to 130cm must be accompanied by a person aged 16 years or over. 2 riders required, minimum of one 130cm+ rider.

Toboggan Run – Riders 90 to 140cm must be accompanied. 140cm+ single riders only.

Bumper Boats – Riders 90cm to 140cm must be accompanied. Max 16 stone. Max 2 riders.

Pedal Boats – Riders 90cm to 140cm must be accompanied. 2-4 riders only.

Master Blaster – Min 90cm (no shoes).

Empire of the Sea Dragon play equipment – 90cm to 110cm must be accompanied (no shoes).

Acrobats challenge, Dizzy Dune Buggies, Bouncy Castle – Min 90cm to Max 140cm (no adults).

Rockin’ Tugboat – Riders 90cm to 105cm accompanied. 105cm+ unaccompanied.

Vertigo – Riders 96cm to 106cm must be accompanied. 106cm+ unaccompanied.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”Minimum Height 110-140cm” tab_id=”1731922978189-8dda62ed-823a”][vc_column_text css=””]Swing Ship – Riders 110cm to 125cm accompanied. 125cm+ unaccompanied.

Trauma Tower – Min 110cm.

Arctic Gliders – Min 110cm. Single riders only. Max 16 stone. Max 16 years.

Ninja Towers – Min 110cm.

Smugglers Ball Pool – Min 110cm to Max 140cm.

Avalanche – 140cm+ Single riders only.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”Minimum Age Attractions” tab_id=”1731922924655-b49c613a-de30″][vc_column_text css=””]Triple Drop Slide – Age 6+

Champion Pedal Carts – Age 6 to 12 years.

Nutty’s Treehouse – Age 5+[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][/vc_tta_accordion][vc_column_text css=””]

Check opening times here to see which rides will be open on the date of your visit.

Please note: The Toboggan Run and Jumping Pillow close when it rains due to health and safety.

[/vc_column_text][vc_btn title=”CLICK HERE to download our Access Statement” style=”3d” shape=”round” color=”warning” size=”lg” align=”center” css=”” link=”url:https%3A%2F%2Fwww.woodlandspark.com%2Fwp-content%2Fuploads%2F2024%2F12%2FWoodlands-Family-Theme-Park-Access-Statement-2024.pdf”][vc_column_text css=””]

Woodlands Safety Regulations

We consider the safety of all visitors to Woodlands to be of paramount importance. All equipment is designed to meet national Health and Safety standards.  The following guidelines, drawn up by Woodlands in liaison with the HSE and BALPPA are for everyone’s safety and are not flexible. IMPORTANT– to allow more supervision and to combat inappropriate behaviour, we offer an excellent free leader ratio for groups. Children under 17 years must be supervised at all times.

Woodlands reserves the right to close any attractions without prior notice. No refunds are given due to bad weather.

All equipment is designed to meet national Health and Safety standards.  The following guidelines, drawn up by Woodlands in liaison with the HSE and BALPPA are for everyone’s safety and are not flexible. IMPORTANT– to allow more supervision and to combat inappropriate behaviour, we offer an excellent free leader ratio for groups. Children under 17 years must be supervised at all times.

 Woodlands reserves the right to close any attractions without prior notice. No refunds are given due to bad weather.

contentHtml:
[vc_row][vc_column][vc_single_image image=”9167″ img_size=”Full” alignment=”center” style=”vc_box_rounded”][/vc_column][vc_column][vc_column_text css=””]

A year of great benefits for £89.50 with a Childminder Annual Pass…

[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=””]

  • Weekday access to Woodlands Park for a whole year*
  • Valid for up to 6 children under 13 years old per visit
  • Transferable between different children
  • Access to our outdoor rides, indoor soft play, 8-acre Zoo Farm, and Falconry.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][vc_column][vc_column_text]

How to buy

Childminder Passes can be purchased online or at the entrance gate. For both options, the childminder will need to fill out our Childminder annual pass form and hand it in on their first visit to the park to verify the pass.[/vc_column_text][vc_btn title=”Buy Pass Now” style=”3d” color=”warning” size=”lg” align=”center” css=”” link=”url:https%3A%2F%2Fwoodlands.digitickets.co.uk%2Ftickets”][vc_column_text css=””]

New Pass

Click the Childminder Annual Pass Form button below to download our Membership Form. Print and fill out the form to bring with you on your next visit to Woodlands. Either pay for your new childminder pass online in advance or at the entrance gate.

Only Ofsted registered childminders can qualify for the Childminder’s Annual Membership. Registration documents must be provided at the time you wish to take the pass out:

  • Woodlands Childminder’s Membership Form completed and signed
  • Childminder’s Ofsted registration certificate
  • Childminder’s registration number
  • Proof of address (must match the registration certificate)
  • Proof of photo ID of the Childminder

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][vc_column][vc_btn title=”Childminder Annual Pass Form” style=”3d” color=”warning” size=”lg” align=”center” css=”” link=”url:https%3A%2F%2Fwww.woodlandspark.com%2Fwp-content%2Fuploads%2F2026%2F01%2FChildminder-Annual-Membership-Form-2026.pdf|target:_blank”][/vc_column][vc_column][vc_column_text css=””]

Renewals

If you are already an existing childminder member looking to renew your pass, you will still need to bring all the documents listed above to the entrance kiosk to complete your renewal. Please also remember to fill out a new membership form as these are updated yearly.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][vc_column][vc_column_text]

FAQs

[/vc_column_text][vc_tta_accordion active_section=”20″ collapsible_all=”true”][vc_tta_section title=”Are Registered Nannies included?” tab_id=”1673190763401-cd60de6e-6bed”][vc_column_text]Registered Nannies are accepted if they are ofsted registered, proof of address has to match the ofsted certificate.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”Can I get an Assistants Pass?” tab_id=”1673190763401-0d2df485-0a87″][vc_column_text]We are sorry but the pass is solely for the use of the Childminder. We do not currently offer a pass for assistants.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”How do I get the membership Pass?” tab_id=”1673190908173-63cd9f6c-68e8″][vc_column_text]Childminder Passes can be purchased either online or in person but must be verified with the correct documentation at the entrance gate on your first visit to the park.

You may also post your Childminder Membership documentation. If you are posting your form to us we need proof of the documents listed above. They can be scanned and printed off and sent to us.  We will not accept emails as the form has to be signed and dated.  We are unable to accept cheques so please make sure there are contact details on the form and we will ring you to take the payment over the phone.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”When is the pass valid?” tab_id=”1673190946995-f06232d3-5631″][vc_column_text css=””]Your new pass is valid for a year from the date of purchase, or when we receive the form (whichever happens first).

Valid Monday – Friday.

The Pass is not valid on Weekends, Bank Holidays, Character Days, or our Charity Day.

2026 Licensed Character Days & Charity day will be revealed in April.

This pass does not include entry into our Seasonal Grottos.

It is valid for up to 6 children under 13 years old.

If you are registered for more than 6 children, we apologise but this pass is a maximum of 6. We do not offer a higher ratio. This is due to safety reasons and is the same ratio set for group visits.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”Can I bring extra children?” tab_id=”1673190981082-fcce3450-fe9f”][vc_column_text]For health and safety reasons the maximum number of children you can bring is 6 per adult. It is the same as our school’s ratio of 1 adult to every 6 children.

You cannot pay for extra children if you are already visiting with 6.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][/vc_tta_accordion][/vc_column][vc_column][vc_column_text css=””]

Terms & Conditions

Bendalls Leisure Ltd reserves the right to withdraw any ticket if the following conditions are not complied with or the company deems it necessary.

The Ticket issued admits the named childminder only. It is not transferable. A Photograph of the childminder must be attached, without one the ticket is not valid. Woodlands Leisure reserve the right to close the park or any attractions without prior notice. Sorry, non-use of the ticket does not entitle the holder to a refund.

  • This membership is only available to Ofsted registered Childminders.
  • This pass is only valid Monday – Friday.
  • This pass is not valid on Weekends or Bank Holidays or Character Days.
  • This pass does not include entry into our Seasonal Grottos.
  • This pass is valid for the Childminder & up to 6 children under 13 years old only.

The Childminder’s Annual pass can be purchased for between 1 and 6 children under 13 years old and is transferable between children as long as the same Childminder is present. Please note if you are registered to look after less than six children the number of children you are registered to look after will be the maximum number of children you can bring to the park each visit under the childminder annual pass.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row]

contentHtml:
[vc_row][vc_column][vc_column_text]

Zoo Rides & Attractions

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row css=”.vc_custom_1465223928270{background-color: #8a0a49 !important;}”][vc_column width=”1/2″ css=”.vc_custom_1465223914419{padding-top: 18px !important;}”][vc_single_image image=”9641″ img_size=”full” alignment=”center” css=”.vc_custom_1681807200822{margin-top: 17px !important;}”][vc_column_text css=”.vc_custom_1681807124623{margin-top: -30px !important;background-color: #d6316d !important;}”]

Tractor Ride

Climb into the life-sized tractors and ride around our very own farmyard. A great ride for little adventurers!

*Children under 110cm must be accompanied.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][vc_column width=”1/2″][vc_single_image image=”9965″ img_size=”full” alignment=”center”][vc_column_text css=”.vc_custom_1693144460074{margin-top: -30px !important;background-color: #d6316d !important;}”]

Rockin’ Tugboat

Navigating the choppy seas on the Rockin’ Tug is dizzying fun! Climb aboard and prepare as the tug spins and rocks!

*Children under 105cm must be accompanied.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][vc_column][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/3″][vc_single_image image=”9642″ img_size=”full” alignment=”center”][vc_column_text css=”.vc_custom_1681807588360{margin-top: -30px !important;background-color: #d6316d !important;}”]

Jumping Pillow

Take flight on the super bouncy jumping pillow with views overlooking the theme park!

*Children 90-120cm must be accompanied.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/3″][vc_single_image image=”9643″ img_size=”full” alignment=”center”][vc_column_text css=”.vc_custom_1693144313530{margin-top: -30px !important;background-color: #d6316d !important;}”]

Pedal Town

Choose your pedal tractor, hitch a trailer and ride around town! This fenced off play area is ideal for little adventurers.

Maximum equipment use height – 100cm.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/3″][vc_single_image image=”9644″ img_size=”full” alignment=”center”][vc_column_text css=”.vc_custom_1681807330879{margin-top: -30px !important;background-color: #d6316d !important;}”]

Safari Adventure Golf

Take a break from the theme park action and get the whole family golfing on this 18-hole safari themed course!

Small additional charge applies.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][vc_column][vc_column_text]

Zoo Farm Rides Information

As well as being home to loads of animals from exotics to farmyard favourites, the Zoo Farm holds a few awesome attractions for guests to visit. These rides are family orientated with something for everyone in mind! Ride the life-size tractors, bounce on the giant jumping pillow, or go for a round of Safari Adventure Golf!

Safari Golf and the Jumping Pillow are not open on off-peak days or during wet weather conditions.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][/vc_column][/vc_row]

Ranger – Rides & Play Areas

We are looking for friendly, responsible Rangers to help supervise our rides and play areas, ensuring every visitor enjoys a fun and safe experience.

This is a hands-on, customer-facing role at our busy Family Theme Park, ideal for someone who is observant, confident, and enjoys working outdoors as part of a team.

Key Responsibilities

  • Supervise rides and play areas to ensure safe operation at all times

  • Explain rules, height restrictions, and safety guidelines clearly to visitors

  • Monitor behaviour and act quickly to prevent unsafe situations

  • Carry out daily cleaning and basic safety checks

  • Report equipment faults or hazards to the Team Leader

  • Assist visitors with enquiries and directions

  • Support opening and closing procedures

(Full health and safety training will be provided.)

About You

  • Friendly, approachable, and customer-focused

  • Calm and confident in busy situations

  • Observant with strong attention to safety

  • Clear communicator with people of all ages and abilities

  • Reliable team player with a positive attitude

  • Flexible and willing to work weekends and Bank Holidays

Hours vary seasonally, with longer days during peak periods such as Easter and the Summer school holidays.

If you enjoy working in an energetic environment and helping create great family experiences, we would love to hear from you.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”Catering Assistant” tab_id=”1771323176360-c35bb769-3b10″][vc_column_text css=””]

Catering Assistant

We are looking for enthusiastic and reliable Catering Assistants to join our busy Leisure Park team. Working across our cafés, fast food outlets, and seasonal kiosks, you will help deliver a friendly, efficient service while maintaining high standards of food hygiene and cleanliness.

This is a hands-on, customer-facing role ideal for someone who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment and being part of a supportive team.

Key Responsibilities

  • Prepare and serve hot and cold food and drinks

  • Take customer orders and process payments using tills

  • Assist with basic cooking and food preparation (full training provided)

  • Maintain a clean, safe, and well-presented work area

  • Follow all food hygiene, safety, and storage procedures

  • Support daily opening and closing tasks

  • Help customers with enquiries in a polite and professional manner

About You

  • Friendly, positive, and customer-focused

  • Confident communicating with people of all ages

  • Able to stay calm and polite during busy periods

  • Reliable, hardworking, and a good team player

  • Flexible and willing to work weekends and Bank Holidays

Hours vary depending on the season, with longer days during peak periods such as Easter and the Summer school holidays.

If you enjoy providing great customer service in a lively environment, we would love to hear from you.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section i_position=”right” i_icon_fontawesome=”fa fa-solid fa-horse” add_icon=”true” title=”Animal Keeper” tab_id=”1770810452772-2ac29dbd-3cce”][vc_column_text css=””]

Animal Keeper – Zoo-Farm

We are looking for a dedicated and enthusiastic Animal Keeper to join our Zoo-Farm team. This hands-on role involves providing excellent daily care to a wide variety of farm and zoo animals, maintaining high welfare standards, and helping create engaging experiences for our visitors.

Key Responsibilities

  • Carry out daily animal health checks and administer treatments as required

  • Prepare and provide correct diets and fresh water

  • Maintain clean, safe, and well-presented enclosures and visitor areas

  • Keep accurate records (health, feeding, breeding, and medication)

  • Assist with breeding programmes and seasonal planning

  • Deliver talks, demonstrations, and animal interaction sessions

  • Ensure high standards of health and safety at all times

About You

  • Qualified in Animal Care/Animal Management (or similar)

  • Knowledgeable and passionate about animal welfare

  • Physically fit and comfortable working outdoors in all weather

  • Confident communicating with visitors of all ages

  • Flexible and willing to work weekends and Bank Holidays

  • Full driving licence required

This is typically a 4–5 day per week position (including weekend day(s)), with flexibility required due to the seasonal nature of the tourism industry.

If you are passionate about animal care and enjoy working as part of a supportive team in a visitor-focused environment, we would love to hear from you.

Click here for the Full Job Description 

How to Apply:

To apply, send your CV to Spiros@woodlandspark.com

[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section i_position=”right” i_icon_fontawesome=”fas fa-tv” add_icon=”true” title=”Administration Assistant” tab_id=”1726730873939-f49f7b51-7cbd”][vc_column_text css=””]Reception & Office Assistant – Permanent or Seasonal

Located at our busy Caravan Park and Family Theme Park, we are recruiting full-time Reception & Office Assistants to join our team on either a permanent or seasonal basis. This is a varied, customer-facing role based at the main hub of the park.

Reception is the centre for enquiries, bookings, arrivals, deliveries, and day-to-day communication, making this an interesting and fast-paced position with plenty of variety.

The Role

You will be responsible for a wide range of reception and office duties, including:

  • Answering telephone and email enquiries
  • Processing and amending bookings for the Caravan Park and Family Theme Park
  • Greeting visitors and checking in arrivals
  • Managing caravan storage accounts
  • Using Microsoft Word, Excel, Access, and Outlook
  • Supporting Managers with administrative duties
  • Filing, laminating, photocopying, and general office tasks

About You

The ideal candidate will:

  • Be highly computer literate with experience using Microsoft Office
  • Be able to absorb and apply a large amount of information
  • Have excellent attention to detail
  • Possess a friendly, confident personality with strong customer service skills
  • Be comfortable with a high level of customer and staff interaction
  • Be willing to work weekends and during school holidays

Full training will be provided on our computerised booking systems.

Additional Information

  • This is a full-time position
  • Weekend and school holiday availability is essential
  • Applicants must be willing to undergo a DBS check

How to Apply

Please email your CV (including your address) to receive an application pack to kate@woodlandspark.com.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section i_position=”right” i_icon_fontawesome=”fas fa-campground” add_icon=”true” title=”Warden Couple” tab_id=”1737303821261-97b8133e-d16b”][vc_column_text css=””]

Seasonal Warden / Ranger Couples – 2026 Season

Set in the beautiful South Devon countryside, just seven miles from the beach and five miles from the waterside town of Dartmouth, Woodlands Park is an AA 5 Gold Pennant award-winning park. Predominantly a Touring Park, we also offer a small number of Glamping Pods and Static Caravans (from May 2026), with award-winning facilities. We are members of the Best of British Quality Touring and Holiday Parks.

We are looking for seasonal, full-time Warden / Ranger couples to join our 2026 team. This key role ensures guests have the best possible experience, both on the campsite and in the Leisure Park.

Key Responsibilities

  • Cleaning & Maintenance: Maintain three sets of amenities, clean Leisure Park toilets, assist with glamping and static caravan changeovers, and carry out light site maintenance. Full training, including COSHH, provided.

  • Guest Services: Welcome guests, show them to their pitch or accommodation, and provide assistance as needed.

  • Leisure Park Duties: Supervise play equipment or rides, and assist in the shop, kiosks, or catering areas.

  • Grounds Upkeep: Light maintenance, strimming, and rubbish collection.

Duties rotate to provide variety. The role is generally five days a week with two consecutive days off, increasing to six during peak summer periods. Rota is provided in advance.

Benefits

  • Minimum wage

  • Free electric pitch for your touring caravan/motorhome, plus discounted meals

  • Onsite accommodation available for those without their own unit (charges apply)

To apply, send your CV to operations@woodlandspark.com or call 01803 712598 (ask for Marcus or Steve).

[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][/vc_tta_accordion][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][/vc_column][/vc_row]

LEGAL NOTICE

In addition to the copyright and trademark notices on the web site the following apply: The written and graphical material which make up the website of Woodlands Leisure Park is provided ‘as is’ with no warranty of guarantee.

Neither Woodlands Leisure Park nor the individual responsible for designing or future editing of this website shall be held responsible for any damage to any electronic, magnetic or mechanical apparatus caused by or in connection with the user of such apparatus viewing or downloading any material contained within this web site.

Emails: Woodlands cannot be held responsible for inaccuracies in prices or information in an email however caused.

Information in all emails is confidential and intended solely for the addressee , if you are not the intended recipient please reply with ‘received in error’ in subject bar then delete this email.

The views expressed are those of the author and not necessarily those of Bendalls Leisure Ltd.

Whilst all emails are swept by anti-virus software, you are solely responsible for ensuring that any email or attachment is virus free. We disclaim liability for any damage you suffer as a consequence of receiving any virus.

If you contact us by email we may store your name and address and assume the right to respond unless you advise us that this is unacceptable.  We will not pass your details to any third party.

DISCLAIMER

Any information provided is so done in ‘good faith’ and believed to be true and not in contravention of either Civil or Criminal Law(as applies in England and Wales). In the event that material on this website is thought to be incorrect or misleading, or thought to be in any way offensive to any person viewing it, or the material(either written of graphical) contained on any page contained on any other website to which a link from this website transfers causes the viewer offence or distress of any kind, please contact the webmaster, who will take all necessary steps to have the offending article removed as soon as practicable.

Although content on sites which may be accessible from time to time via links contained on Woodlands Leisure Park’s site was thought appropriate at the time the link was initiated neither the webmaster of Woodlands Leisure Park in particular, nor Woodlands Leisure Park in general, have control over the content of these sites and warn those following these links that the content may have changed from that which was current at the time when the link was initiated.

PHOTOGRAPHY

By entering the park you consent to us photographing or filming you and using the resulting pictures for any promotional purpose without payment to you. Photos taken will be also used on our Social Media Pages. If you do not wish to be photographed or filmed, please visit reception on arrival who will be able to provide you with a sticker to show you do not wish to be photographed or filmed.

LOG FILES / IP ADDRESSES

When you visit the Woodlands website, we automatically log your IP address (the unique address which identifies your computer on the internet) which is automatically recognised by our web server. We only use IP addresses if you make an enquiry with us. This only provides broad demographic information for aggregate use, not personally identify information.

NON PERSONAL INFORMATION

We may automatically collect non-personal information about you such as the type of internet browser / device you use, or the site from which you linked to our website. You cannot be identified from this information and it is only used to assist in providing and effective service on our website. For more information please see http://woodlandspark.com/privacy.

ONLINE WINTER DATED TICKETS

– Tickets bought online are non-refundable for any reason.

– Tickets are dated tickets and are only valid on the date which is booked.

To change the date on your ticket: A £5 charge applies. You will need to call Woodlands Reception Team on 01803 712598 who will be able to change your ticket for a fee of £5 per booking number.

ONLINE TICKETS

10% off, 30% off and Special Offer tickets are available to purchase online for a specific date.

– Tickets bought online are non-refundable for any reason.

– Tickets are dated tickets and are only valid on the date which is booked.

To change the date on your ticket: A £5 charge applies. You need to call Woodlands Reception Team on 01803 712598 who will be able to change your ticket for a fee of £5 per booking number.

EMAILS

Woodlands Family Theme Park cannot be held responsible for inaccuracies in prices or information in an email however caused. Information in all emails is confidential and intended solely for the addressee, if you are not the intended recipient please reply with ‘received in error’ in subject bar then delete this email.
The views expressed are those of the author and not necessarily those of Woodlands Family Theme Park. Whilst all emails are swept by anti-virus software, you are solely responsible for ensuring that any email or attachment is virus free. We disclaim liability for any damage you suffer as a consequence of receiving any virus.
If you contact us by email we may store your name and address and assume the right to respond unless you advise us that this is unacceptable. We will not pass your details to any third party.

ON SITE GENERAL INFORMATION

  • We are prepared to allow entry to the park to those visitors willing to comply with the Park regulations set out below. Whilst inside the park all visitors must comply with any instructions given to them by Woodlands personnel.
  • Woodlands Leisure reserves the right to close the Park or any attraction, ride or playzone without prior notice.
  • Closure of any ride or area of the Park will not entitle visitors to a refund of admission fee.
  • All persons entering the Park must pay for admission or hold a valid admission ticket. If re-entry into the Park is required, you must obtain an appropriate hand stamp, before exiting the Park which must be shown at the time of re-entry to gain access to the Park.
  • Admission tickets are non-exchangeable, non-refundable and void if altered. Admission tickets will only be exchanged or refunded if Woodlands, in its absolute discretion, chooses to do so.
  • Any person who does not comply with these Entry Conditions may be removed from the Attraction by personnel or police officers, without any right to a refund.  This is without prejudice to any claim that we may have against such a person or arising out of their actions.
  • Whilst inside the Park and its grounds, all guests must comply with any reasonable instructions given to them by the staff or any third party instructed on our behalf.
  • Acting reasonably, Woodlands reserves the right to vary these Entry Conditions at any time without prior notice.
    By entering the Attraction, guests accept that they have a duty to take reasonable steps to ensure their own safety, taking into account any personal medical conditions.  All persons in and around the Attraction should behave in a safe manner at all times.
  • All Children under the age of 17 need to be accompanied by an adult. Children (under 17) whilst in the Park must remain under the control or supervision of an adult (17 years or over) at all times.
  • Sensible clothing and footwear must be worn at all times when in and about the Park. Please note that shirts and shoes (or socks if shoes are not permitted) must be worn on all rides at all times.
  • Vehicles are parked at owner’s risk. Woodlands takes no responsibility for damage caused to any vehicle using the car park.  We do not guarantee the security of your vehicle and / or its contents.
  • Alcohol or illegal substances may not be taken into the Park. Guests who appear to be under the influence of alcohol or illegal substances may be refused admission to the Park or escorted from the Park without right to refund.
  • All rides, attractions, amusements and other facilities must only be used in accordance with the operator’s instructions. The use of illegal substances is strictly prohibited and any persons found possessing, using or who appear to be under the influence of illegal substances will be refused admission or escorted from the Park without right to refund.

SOCIAL MEDIA COMPETITIONS

Please read these competition rules carefully. If you enter one of our competitions on any of our social media websites, we will assume that you have read these rules and that you agree to them.

Competitions run on Facebook, Twitter, Google Plus and Instagram are in no way sponsored, endorsed or administered by, or associated with any of the above companies. By participating you hereby release and hold harmless any of the above companies from any and all liability associated with this promotion.

The closing date is as specified in each competition, and Woodlands reserves the right to amend the competition end date at any time.

To enter a competition you must be: (a) UK resident; and (b) 17 years old or over at the time of entry.

Competitions are not open to employees (or members of their immediate families) of Woodlands Family Theme Park, Twinlakes Family Theme Park or Wheelgate Family Theme Park.

No purchase necessary.

Only one entry per person.

[vc_row][vc_column][vc_column_text]

PRIVACY AND COOKIES POLICY STATEMENT

We at Woodlands Leisure Park respect you and your right to privacy and consider that privacy to be of paramount importance and a fundamental right of the individual. We endorse and comply with the provisions of the Data Protection Act. Woodlands Leisure Park is the sole owner of any and all the information that may be collected on this web site, including personal information about you and/or your business(which includes e-mail addresses).
We may from time to time, gather only information we need in order to serve you better and will not, without you informed consent, sell, give, share, rent or disclose this information with others(either individuals, government agencies or bodies corperate) in ways that differ from that which is disclosed in this statement except in cases where in good faith we beleive that:

The law appertaining at that time requires us to do so
There is a court order in place compelling us to do so
It is necessary to protect Woodlands Leisure Park’s rights and/or property
If circumstances necessitate acting to protect the personal safety or privacy of staff or of the general public.
Your acceptance of these privacy statement terms
By using any of the website or our service, you unconditionally agree to be bound to this privacy policy.

Our privacy Policy

Keeping your personal information safe and secure is our top priority. All your personal information will be held and used in accordance to the General Data Protection Regulation 2016/679 by Woodlands Family Theme Park & Woodlands Grove Caravan and Camping Park.

Your information will only be used in the following ways:

  • To maintain an updated list of customers
  • To maintain and use an updated mailing list, for the dissemination of Woodlands Family Theme Park
  • To respond to queries by email

What information do we collect?

  • When you visit our website you may provide us with information such as name, address, postcode, email address, mobile phone number, credit or debit card details and information when purchasing booking your tickets or purchasing gift vouchers.
  • By corresponding with us by email, in which case we may retain the content of your email messages together with your email address and our responses.

What do we do with the information?

  • We use your information to contact you via email in regards to upcoming promotions, events and latest news.
  • To answer any queries you may have about the parks.

How long do we hold your information?

  • We only retain your information for as long as is necessary for the purpose or purposes for which we have collected it.

How do we contact you?

  • We may contact you to provide the services that you have purchased or registered for. Depending on your preferences and the information you have provided we may contact you by post, email, telephone or text messaging.

Protecting your information

We have appropriate security measures in place in our physical facilities to protect against the loss, misuse or alteration of information that we have collected from you via our websites. The internet  sometimes is not a secure medium of communication. Woodlands Family Theme Park cannot guarantee the security of any information you input on this website or send to us on the internet.

Children’s Privacy

Children’s Privacy is of upmost importance to us. We do not knowingly collect information from children under the age of 14 without obtaining parental consent.

Links to other websites

The website may contain links that make it easier for users to visit other websites. If you use the links to leave this website and to visit one operated by a third party, we will not have any control over that website, or its use of cookies.

Woodlands Family Theme Park cannot be responsible for your protection and privacy when visiting such websites. You should check the privacy policies of those websites before entering any personal information.

Changes to our Privacy Policy

If we decide to change our Privacy Policy, we will post the changes on this page.

Contact Us

If you have any questions regarding our Privacy Policy, please contact us via email: fun@woodlandspark.com

 

 

What are cookies?

Cookies are pieces of information that a website transfers to your hard drive to store and sometimes track information about you. Most web browsers automatically accept cookies, but if you prefer, you can change your browser to prevent that. However, you may not be able to take full advantage of our website if you do so. Cookies are specific to the server that created them and cannot be accessed by other users, which means they cannot be used to track your movements around the web. Although they do identify a user’s computer, cookies do not personally identify customers or passwords. Your Credit/Debit card information is not stored in cookies.
We use cookies to help improve the website so you can find the information that you are looking for easily, complete transactions quickly, share content and use features on our site like video and search.

Cookies do not harm your computer in any way.

We are providing this information as part of our privacy and cookie-related improvements to the website to comply with recent EU legislation changes and to help you understand about your privacy when using our site.

Our cookies policy

To make full use and access all of the features and functionality on our website your computer or device will need to accept cookies.

The cookies stored do not hold any sensitive information like your name, address or payment details. If you would prefer to block, restrict or delete cookies from us or any other website, you can use your browsers settings to do this. Click ‘’help’’ in your browser for further information.

Cookies set by this website

There are two types of cookie you may encounter when using this site; ‘First party cookies’ and ‘Third party cookies’.

First party cookies: these are our own cookies and are necessary in order for this website to function.
Third party cookies: these are cookies found in other companies’ internet tools which we are using to enhance our site.

As this site uses different cookies in several places – we’ve listed each of them below with more details about why we use them and how long they will last.

First party cookies:
Name: SESSxxxID
Purpose: Authentication session to prevent having to login multiple times in one browser session.
Typical content: A unique id that ties the current session to a database settings table.
Expires: One week.

Name: has_js
Purpose: This helps the website understand your web browser’s Javascript functionality.
Typical content: An on/off flag that denotes whether or not the browser supports Javascript.
Expires: When you close your browser.

Third party cookies:
We use Google Analytics who also set cookies on your machine when you visit this website. This site does not control the dissemination of these cookies.

Provider: Google Analytics
Name: __utma
Purpose: Provides a unique ID for each web browser that visits this site.
Expires: 2 years from set/update.

Provider: Google Analytics
Name: __utmb
Purpose: Used to establish and continue a user session with this website.
Expires: 30 minutes from set/update.

Provider: Google Analytics
Name: _utmc
Purpose: Used to establish and continue a user session with this website.
Expires: When you close your browser.

Provider: Google Analytics
Name: _utmz
Purpose: Used to calculate search engine traffic, ad campaigns and page navigation within this site.
Expires: 6 months from set/update.

If you would like more information, please refer to Cookies & Google Analytics and Google’s Privacy Policy.

Please email any questions, concerns or comments you have about our privacy policy to fun@woodlandspark.com or write to us at:

Woodlands Leisure Park,
Blackawton,
Totnes,
Devon,
TQ9 7DQ

Tel: 01803 712598

Information on cookies
To learn more general information on cookies and how to manage them visit aboutcookies.org.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row]

contentHtml:
The Golden Bear Story Box is an innovative teaching experience for younger children. Piloted by 10 Primary School and Preschools in June 2010 the teachers reported it was a very positive and enjoyable learning experience.

Written for Early Foundation Stage and Key Stage 1 the books are to be read aloud. The first book ‘Meet Golden Bear and Prairie Dog Pete’ is read to the children in class. The children can then visit Golden Bear City for the second story ‘We are Pioneers’.

Subjects

Interaction
Counting
Friendship
Environment
Life skills
History
Role play
Language
Self confidence
Imagination
World knowledge
Art
For information on the Golden Bear City Story Boxes or to book a school group visit call Woodlands Family Theme Park on 01803 712598.

[vc_row][vc_column][vc_single_image image=”9398″ img_size=”full” alignment=”center”][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][vc_column_text]

Visiting Woodlands Family Theme Park as a Group

Woodlands is an ideal destination for a group day out in Devon. With a Zoo Farm home to a wide range of animals, superb Falconry Centre, and fun rides, we believe there is a perfect combination of fun, learning opportunities, and facilities for everyone to enjoy.

During our Fully Open season and Summer Fun season we are able to cater for large groups of all sizes.

During our Off-Peak Term Time and Winter seasons the minimum number for a group booking is 50.

All group bookings benefit from group rate discounts and group meal options at great value prices.

[/vc_column_text][vc_separator][/vc_column][vc_column][vc_column_text]

Booking a group visit

Group bookings need to be booked in advance with our reception team with a £75 non-refundable deposit made at the time of booking with a debit or credit card payment.

We are unable to accept cheque or BACS payment for the deposit.

[/vc_column_text][vc_tta_accordion active_section=”5″ collapsible_all=”true”][vc_tta_section title=”How to book?” tab_id=”1677588060616-5b52193b-dbee”][vc_column_text css=””]Once you have approximate group numbers and a visiting date, simply give our friendly team a ring on 01803 712598 and we will be able to provide you with a quote price for your group visit.

Please make sure you book your group in advance preferably at least 2 weeks before you come.

Call us now on 01803 712598 or email us on fun@woodlandspark.com[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”What’s included with your booking?” tab_id=”1677588060617-722b682c-6586″][vc_column_text css=””]Guests visiting as part of a group benefit from:

  • Access to Woodlands Family Theme Park including rides, attractions, soft play, falconry centre and zoo farm.
  • Free entry for leaders (ratio depends on group booking type)
  • Free coach/car parking

Optional:

  • Group meal vouchers (must be pre-booked £8.95pp)
  • Optional educational falconry talk (must be pre-booked)

[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”Where is Woodlands located?” tab_id=”1677588803818-6c355ae0-93dc”][vc_column_text]Woodlands is located in South Devon between Dartmouth and Totnes.

Address: Woodlands Family Theme Park, Blackawton, Totnes, South Devon, TQ9 7DQ

There is plenty of directional signage for the park once you get close. For exact instructions on how to get to us click here.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][/vc_tta_accordion][vc_btn title=”View Our Opening Times” style=”3d” shape=”round” color=”warning” size=”lg” align=”center” i_icon_fontawesome=”far fa-clock” css=”” add_icon=”true” link=”url:https%3A%2F%2Fwww.woodlandspark.com%2Fyour-visit%2Finformation%2Fopening-times%2F|target:_blank”][vc_separator][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][vc_column_text css=””]

Group Meal Options

At Woodlands we offer a fantastic deal for groups on meal vouchers at only £9.95pp.

What meals are there?

  • Burger, chips, and a drink
  • Cheeseburger, chips, and a drink
  • Sausage bap, chips, and a drink
  • Jacket potato, one filling and a drink
  • Veggie burger, chips, and a drink

Group Meal Vouchers must be prebooked before your visit. For more Group information please talk to our reception team on 01803712598[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][vc_separator][vc_tta_accordion active_section=”27″ collapsible_all=”true”][vc_tta_section title=”School Groups” tab_id=”1488458690110-d7613010-0e0f”][vc_column_text]Woodlands Family Theme Park is a fantastic choice for school visits, from preschools through to university students – learning works best when it’s fun!

Schools return to Woodlands year after year. Teachers tell us it is an easy, safe venue providing a wide variety of experiences.

We are happy to provide educational talks on certain areas in the park. For more information please contact fun@woodlandspark.com

The wide range of quality indoor entertainment ensures rain does not spoil the visit. The combination of excellent discounts, a generous ratio of 1 staff member free for every 6 children makes Woodlands the perfect day out in Devon for school visits.

To book your group in please call our friendly team on 01803 712598 and pay your £75.00 non refundable deposit with a Credit or Debit card. The remaining balance is paid on the day you arrive.

For prices please contact our Reception team on 01803 712598 or email fun@woodlandspark.com.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”Friends and Family” tab_id=”1488458690111-93e6e0ac-96b4″][vc_column_text]Woodlands is the perfect day out in Devon for a large group of friends and family.

If you are visiting during our Main Season or the summer holidays and you’re in a group of 20 or more then you could get great value discounted prices if you make a group booking.

To book your group in please call our friendly team on 01803 712598 and pay your £75.00 non refundable deposit with a credit or debit card. The remaining balance is paid on the day you arrive. We are unable to accept cheque or BACS payment for the deposit. 

For prices please contact our Reception team on 01803 712598 or email fun@woodlandspark.com.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”Youth Groups” tab_id=”1488458772888-1aff3bfc-fb5e”][vc_column_text]Woodlands Family Theme Park is a fantastic choice for a day out in Devon with plenty to do for all ages.  We offer brilliant group discounts for youth organisations and fantastic free leader ratios which will provide your group with a great value day out at the top attraction in Devon.

To book your group in please call our friendly team on 01803 712598 and pay your £75.00 non refundable deposit with a credit or debit card. The remaining balance is paid on the day you arrive. We are unable to accept cheque or BACS payment for the deposit. 

For prices please contact our Reception team on 01803 712598 or email fun@woodlandspark.com.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”Scouts, Brownies, Beavers or Cubs Organisations” tab_id=”1488458951545-0b8a9e1f-c9b5″][vc_column_text css=””]Woodlands has an excellent reputation for entertaining scouting organisations. We love welcoming hundreds of Scouts to the park every year!

To book your group in please call our friendly team on 01803 712598 and pay your £75.00 non refundable deposit with a credit or debit card. The remaining balance is paid on the day you arrive. We are unable to accept cheque or BACS payment for the deposit. 

From 27th March – 1st November 2026 we also offer Play & Stay Camps at our adjoining 5 star campsite. Woodlands Caravan & Camping site is located right next to Woodlands Theme Park with stays including free use of all the rides & attractions at the theme park. It is an excellent choice for groups looking to enjoy a great value trip away either in a caravan, motorhome or tent.

For more details regarding our play and stay camps please call our reception team on 01803 712598 who will be more than happy to help you with your stay.

For prices please contact our Reception team on 01803 712598 or email fun@woodlandspark.com.[/vc_column_text][vc_btn title=”Visit the Woodlands Caravan and Camping” style=”3d” shape=”round” color=”success” size=”lg” align=”center” i_icon_fontawesome=”” css=”” add_icon=”true” link=”url:https%3A%2F%2Fwww.woodlandsgrove.co.uk%2Frallies-groups%2F|target:_blank”][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”Language Schools” tab_id=”1490781100244-67fa46c3-cda2″][vc_column_text]

Whether your group is here to study English, learn another language or just experience English Culture we offer a fantastic group package for a fun day out at Woodlands. It will be the perfect day full of adventure and fun to add to your leisure excursion programme for your students.

Your entry cost per student will include:
– Park entrance
– Free leaders
– Free coach/car parking
– Park maps for every student
– Optional falconry talk (must be pre-booked)
– A free pre visit for the group organiser
– Pre-booked Group meal vouchers are also available (extra charge applies)

How to book?

Simply email fun@woodlandspark.com or give our friendly team a ring and we will be able to sort out your fantastic group visit to Woodlands Park, the largest adventure park in the South West. Please make sure you book your group in, in advance preferably 2 weeks before you come.

For prices please contact our Reception team on 01803 712598 or email fun@woodlandspark.com.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”Organisational Guest with Disabilities Group” tab_id=”1579014446807-a0534305-7b2f”][vc_column_text]Organisational Guest with Disabilities group visits receive a personalised group rate.

For prices please contact our Reception team on 01803 712598 or email fun@woodlandspark.com.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”Birthday Parties” tab_id=”1490781026661-9c580584-67d0″][vc_column_text]For Birthday Party Bookings please click here[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][/vc_tta_accordion][/vc_column][/vc_row]

[vc_row][vc_column][vc_single_image image=”10194″ img_size=”full” alignment=”center” style=”vc_box_rounded” css_animation=”none” css=””][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][vc_column_text css_animation=”none” css=””]

Become a Woodlands Annual Pass holder today and enjoy great benefits for an entire year…

  • Unlimited access to Woodlands Family Theme Park for a whole year
  • Free entry to our special guest events and character appearances
  • 15% off Gift Shop purchases
  • 10% off Catering
  • Access to seasonal grottos *additional charges required
  • Birthday Party discounts
  • 20% OFF at Woodlands Caravan & Camping when booking a camping or touring pitch during a Tariff A period! Visit our Caravan & Camping website

Wave goodbye to booking! As an annual pass holder you can turn up whenever we’re open without booking in advance. 

[/vc_column_text][vc_btn title=”Buy Annual Passes” color=”warning” size=”lg” align=”center” css=”” link=”url:https%3A%2F%2Fwoodlands.digitickets.co.uk%2Fcategory%2F69171″][vc_tta_accordion active_section=”10″ collapsible_all=”true”][vc_tta_section title=”What’s included with an Annual Pass?” tab_id=”1672836802282-035aa1d3-58d2″][vc_column_text css=””]Your annual pass grants unlimited free access to Woodlands Family Theme Park during opening hours including outdoor rides, indoor soft play, our 8-acre Zoo Farm, and Falconry.

During school holidays see amazing live guest appearances… from your favourite TV characters to educational shows… there’s something for everyone and at no extra charge.

Stay refreshed during your Woodlands adventure and leave with a souvenir! Benefit from onsite discounts including 15% off at our gift shop and 10% off catering.

Enjoy a fantastic 20% OFF when booking your camping or touring pitch during Tariff A periods at Woodlands Caravan & Camping! This exclusive perk is valid throughout the following dates – 27th March-21st May | 1st June – 2nd July | 7th Sept – 1st Nov 2026. Applies to caravan & camping stays during Tariff A dates only. Discount cannot be applied to glamping pod stays.

All our seasonal grottos (including Christmas!) always have annual pass ticket options, so you only pay for the grotto extras, not what you are already entitled to.

Annual pass holders receive big birthday discounts! Invite your friends, explore the park, and enjoy a delicious meal, all at a great price.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”Woodlands Caravan & Camping Discount T&Cs” tab_id=”1705923718911-98ef028b-a6a0″][vc_column_text css=””]

20% off when booking your touring pitch during Tariff A periods at Woodlands Caravan & Camping.

How to claim your discount:

  1. Purchase your Woodlands Family Theme Park Annual Pass
  2. Head to www.woodlandsgrove.co.uk to book your touring pitch (Valid ONLY during Tariff A dates)
  3. Dates are as follows:- 27th March -21st May | 1st June – 2nd July | 7th Sept – 1st Nov 2026

*Your whole stay must fall within these dates*

  1. Input the discount code given upon completion of your Annual Pass Purchase. This will be included in your annual pass confirmation email.
  2. All guests booking a Caravan Park pitch must hold a valid annual pass at the time of booking and for the duration of your stay to qualify for the 20% off discount rate. (Failure to comply will result in cancellation of your holiday) you are unable to make a booking and receive the discount unless all of your booking party hold a valid annual pass, as we are unable to proportion partial costs for the discount.
  3. Annual Passes that don’t match will result in termination of your booking
  4. Offer is NOT applicable in Tariff B Dates.
  5. Annual pass discount is exclusive to annual pass holders, NOT friends & family that may be visiting during the same period.
  6. Standard booking policies apply.
  7. Standard cancellation policies apply.
  8. A deposit is required with this booking and is non-refundable.
  9. Applies to caravan & camping stays during Tariff A dates only. Discount cannot be applied to glamping pod stays.
  10. Terms and Conditions are subject to change at any time and is at the discretion of Bendalls Leisure Ltd.

2026 Prices

How to Buy

Online

Buying your Woodlands Annual Pass online is easy! Click the button below to visit our tickets page. Once on the tickets page you will be able to select the annual passes option, then simply follow the steps to buy your new annual pass.

On the Day

Ask for an annual pass at the entrance kiosk next time you visit the park. One of our Rangers will set up your new annual pass with you.

Try & Buy

Try before you buy! Upgrade to an annual pass on the day you visit and we will deduct your day entrance fee from the price of the new pass. (Till receipt or online booking number is needed). Upgrade must be made during your visit. We are unable to claim the price of day entrance against your annual pass after you leave the park on the day of your visit.[/vc_column_text][vc_btn title=”Buy Annual Passes” style=”3d” color=”warning” size=”lg” align=”center” css=”” link=”url:https%3A%2F%2Fwoodlands.digitickets.co.uk%2Fcategory%2F69171″][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][vc_column_text css=””]

Annual Pass Form

Save time setting up your annual passes in person! Download and fill out your 2026 annual pass form here.

This form will contain all the information we need to get you set up!

[/vc_column_text][vc_separator border_width=”2″][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][vc_tta_accordion active_section=”10″ collapsible_all=”true”][vc_tta_section title=”What evidence do I need to qualify for a Guest with Disability Annual Pass?” tab_id=”1705319676788-b3bb14e9-e831″][vc_column_text]To protect the integrity of our Guest with Disability Annual Pass discount price, we ask that customers who have purchased this pass bring one of the following forms of evidence with them on their first visit to the park: DLA Letter, PIP Letter, Blue Badge, Access Card or D.I.D Card.

Without one of these forms of evidence, we won’t be able to verify your pass.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”What evidence do I need to qualify for a Senior Citizen Annual Pass?” tab_id=”1705320086959-69278840-fbea”][vc_column_text]Proof of age that includes a photo (for example either passport or driving license) will need to be shown upon your first visit to the park to verify your pass.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][/vc_tta_accordion][/vc_column][/vc_row]
