contentHtml:
[vc_row][vc_column css=”.vc_custom_1495633272114{padding-top: 60px !important;}”][vc_column_text css=”.vc_custom_1689509750742{margin-top: -30px !important;padding-top: 20px !important;padding-right: 20px !important;padding-bottom: 20px !important;padding-left: 20px !important;background-color: #820a34 !important;}”]

General Park Accessibility

Woodlands Family Theme Park has endeavoured to create a wheelchair and pushchair friendly environment. All main paths are surfaced with tarmac and seating is available in all play zones. Due to the park’s location in a natural valley, gradients should be expected. Whilst all areas of the park have been designed with accessibility in mind, some of the natural hills are steep and may be difficult to navigate independently in a manual wheelchair. Apologies but we do not have any wheelchairs available for hire on site.

If you have any questions before your visit, please contact our reception team on 01803 712598. On the day our rangers will be on hand to assist in creating the most accommodating environment possible.

Disabled parking is available on the front rows of both our lower and upper car parks. The car parks are surfaced with gravel and these spaces ensure the least distance from the car park to the smooth tarmac pathways at the entrance gate.

We do not currently offer any kind of ride fast track pass. Our Rangers aim to work through ride queues as quickly as possible. However, if a member of your group is struggling to queue for any particular ride, please speak to the ride operator or a nearby ranger and they will be able to assist. This could involve a member of your group holding their place in the queue whilst the guest waits on nearby benches or play equipment.[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=”.vc_custom_1713968638500{padding-top: 20px !important;padding-right: 20px !important;padding-bottom: 20px !important;padding-left: 20px !important;background-color: #820a34 !important;}”]

Toilet Facilities

Guest with disabilities toilet facilities are situated at various locations around the theme park and at all facilities buildings on the campsite. Below the Treasure Trove Gift Shop, inside Empire of the Sea Dragon, and at Loves Grove Cafe there are spacious disabled toilet rooms with appropriate fittings. Baby changing facilities are also accessible at each of these areas.[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=”.vc_custom_1733243239242{padding-top: 20px !important;padding-right: 20px !important;padding-bottom: 20px !important;padding-left: 20px !important;background-color: #820a34 !important;}”]

Guest with Disability Tickets

A reduced rate is offered for guests with disabilities on general park admission tickets in all seasons throughout the year. These tickets are labelled as ‘Guest with Disability’ tickets on our website. Please visit the ticketing page for more information.

Please bring a form of evidence with you when you arrive for your visit as you may be asked to present this at the entrance kiosk.

Acceptable forms of evidence:

  • DLA Letter
  • PIP Letter
  • Blue Badge
  • National Disabled ID Card
  • Nimbus Access Card

Carers – We do not offer free entry for carers instead we offer discounted prices for the guest with disabilities.

If you are visiting as a group, please visit our Group Visits page for more information on group rates and benefits.[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=”.vc_custom_1713869152715{padding-top: 20px !important;padding-right: 20px !important;padding-bottom: 20px !important;padding-left: 20px !important;background-color: #820a34 !important;}”]

Assistance Dogs

Fully trained assistance dogs are welcome at Woodlands Family Theme Park.

For health and safety reasons we are unable to allow pet dogs in the theme park. Kennels are provided for visitors on a first come first served basis and are non-bookable. Woodlands is not responsible for the welfare of your dog, watering or feeding whilst using the kennels. Please ensure the kennel is left clean and tidy. Thank you.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row]

2) View rides and attractions height restrictions list, this can be found here: Height Restrictions

3) Once you’re ready to book click the big TICKETS button and select the appropriate tickets for your visit. Tickets booked online before the day of entry are 30% off![/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”I have a complimentary ticket?” tab_id=”1593598252026-0870881d-8a50″][vc_column_text]A complimentary ticket is a ticket that holds no monetary value. For example: a Woodlands ticket you have won in a raffle that admits one or two people.

Complimentary tickets can be redeemed at the entrance gate on the day of your visit. Complimentary tickets entitle the guest(s) to one visit only, unless otherwise stated.

This is not a Gift Voucher. Gift vouchers are used as a payment option similar to cash or card. This is also not an Annual Pass entry ticket.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”I have a £3 off Voucher from your leaflet, can I use this?” tab_id=”1593598351435-27c3cbbc-117e”][vc_column_text]These vouchers are only valid against tickets purchased at our entrance gate on arrival, during Park Fully Open & Summer Fun seasons. Please see terms and conditions printed on the voucher.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”I have a Devon’s Top Attractions Entry Ticket, can i use this?” tab_id=”1593598600805-986dbb67-1594″][vc_column_text]As a member of Devon’s Top Attractions you are able to use your complimentary tickets here.

Accepted tickets are Golden Tickets, Admits 2 and Family tickets. These are all valid during school holidays but not bank holidays. Please check the terms & conditions of your tickets carefully before visiting. Complimentary tickets can be redeemed at the entrance gate on the day of your visit.

 

Devon’s Top Attractions Staff Tickets are accepted at Woodlands however as per DATA rules these are not valid in school holidays.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”I have a Twinlakes or Wheelgate Annual Pass, do I get a discount?” tab_id=”1745156663061-859d91ae-749c”][vc_column_text css=””]Twinlakes and Wheelgate Annual Pass Holders can receive 20% off Woodlands day entry tickets when purchasing them at the entrance kiosk.

Please bring proof of your Annual Pass (e.g. email receipt).[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][/vc_tta_accordion][vc_custom_heading text=”Opening Times and Prices” google_fonts=”font_family:Roboto%3A100%2C100italic%2C300%2C300italic%2Cregular%2Citalic%2C500%2C500italic%2C700%2C700italic%2C900%2C900italic|font_style:400%20regular%3A400%3Anormal”][vc_tta_accordion active_section=”” collapsible_all=”true”][vc_tta_section title=”What does the entry price to Woodlands Park include?” tab_id=”1593449094664-ba115365-a198″][vc_column_text]The admission price includes entry to Woodlands Family Theme Park and the use of all the rides and attractions*

*With the exception of the Safari Adventure Golf, Teddy Mountain (Build your own teddy), coin operated and seasonal amusements. Height restrictions do apply on rides. A number of rides are closed during the Off Peak and winter season.

Please click here for our park and ride opening times[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”What times do the rides and attractions open and close?” tab_id=”1593449094834-e0d2dce9-ef40″][vc_column_text css=””]This does vary dependant on the time of year.

During the main season and off-peak weekdays the park opens at 9:30am, the rides from 10am and closes at 5pm.

In the winter fun season the park is open from 10:30am to 4:30pm

We recommend checking the opening times page for the most up to date information.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”Is the park open all year?” tab_id=”1593449094996-1146ac84-bf29″][vc_column_text]

The opening times for the 2024 season have changed.

Please check the opening times page on our website for each seasons opening times

Woodlands park is open daily during the season from Easter – End of October half-term.

In the Winter Woodlands opens every weekend and Devon School Holidays.

The following rides are closed during the Off Peak Term Time & Winter Fun Seasons: Watercoasters, Toboggan Run, Pedal Boats, Arctic Gliders, Dune Buggies, Avalanche, Jumping Pillow, Safari Adventure Golf.[/vc_column_text][vc_btn title=”CHECK OPENING TIMES” style=”3d” shape=”round” color=”warning” size=”lg” align=”center” i_icon_fontawesome=”far fa-clock” add_icon=”true” link=”url:http%3A%2F%2Fwoodlandspark.com%2Fyour-visit%2Finformation%2Fopening-times%2F|||”][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”Are there any additional charges when we have paid to come into Woodlands Park?” tab_id=”1593449095235-4c182a81-e8b2″][vc_column_text]There are additional charges for the Safari Adventure Golf and coin operated amusement machines.

During seasonal periods there may be themed grottos which require an additional charge for access.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”Are there any admission concessions?” tab_id=”1593449095398-714f6605-c66a”][vc_column_text]We offer concessions for the following:

Children under 92cms are admitted free of charge. Please Note: Children are measured with their shoes on.

Special concessions for children between 92cm – 110cm, Senior Citizens (60+) and Guests with Disabilities.

Carers Ticket
We do not offer free entry for carers instead we offer a high discounted price for the Guest with Disabilities.

Special concessions for groups of 10 or more paying guests.

Full details on Woodlands Family Theme Park Admissions Pricing can be found on our ticket prices page.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”Do you accept Debit/Credit Card?” tab_id=”1593449095583-9da04ed5-3a5f”][vc_column_text]We accept debit and credit card on the entrance kiosk but are unable to take American Express.
Minimum transaction is £5[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][/vc_tta_accordion][vc_custom_heading text=”Online Ticket Help” google_fonts=”font_family:Roboto%3A100%2C100italic%2C300%2C300italic%2Cregular%2Citalic%2C500%2C500italic%2C700%2C700italic%2C900%2C900italic|font_style:400%20regular%3A400%3Anormal”][vc_tta_accordion active_section=”” collapsible_all=”true”][vc_tta_section title=”What’s included in the ticket price?” tab_id=”1463138105458-2f2ea65c-7c58″][vc_column_text]The admission price includes entry to Woodlands Family Theme Park and the use of all the rides and attractions*

*With the exception of the Safari Adventure Golf, coin operated and seasonal amusements.

Height restrictions do apply on rides. A number of rides are closed during the winter and off peak term time seasons. Please check information on tickets page to see what’s open during your visit.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”When are tickets valid for?” tab_id=”1463138105597-a3a743bb-03e6″][vc_column_text]Tickets to Woodlands Park are dated meaning they are only valid on the day you select when booking.

To change the date on your ticket: This needs to be done 24 hours before your visit and a £5 charge applies. You will need to call Woodlands Reception Team on 01803 712598 who will be able to change your ticket for a fee of £5 per booking number.

The 30% off discount is only available when you purchase your tickets online and at least 24 hours in advance. (During Fully Open & Summer Fun Seasons)

The 10% off discount is only available online and is available when you buy tickets on the day you wish to visit. (During Fully Open & Summer Fun Seasons)[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”Can I get a refund if I can’t use my ticket?” tab_id=”1463138198702-d5785f09-ee72″][vc_column_text]Refunds are not available for any purchases.

To change the date on your ticket: This needs to be done 24 hours before your visit and a £5 charge applies. You will need to call Woodlands Reception Team on 01803 712598 who will be able to change your ticket for a fee of £5 per booking number.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”What is included in a family Ticket?” tab_id=”1463138228391-3671514d-0c13″][vc_column_text]A family ticket includes any persons over 110cm in height, these can be adults, children or any combination of them. Children between 92cm – 110cm are classed as a adventurer and get a concession. Infants under 92cms are free of charge and do not require a ticket.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”How do I know if my children are eligible for free entry?” tab_id=”1463138258025-2ff38294-a740″][vc_column_text]Only children under 92cms are admitted free of charge. Additional tickets will be available to purchase at admissions if required. Children’s height will be measured at Admissions – shoes must be worn. If you are unsure please do not purchase an online ticket as we are not able to refund tickets.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”Can I get a refund if one person doesn’t come?” tab_id=”1463138292741-5eaec296-d33b”][vc_column_text]Refunds are not available for any purchases made online.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][/vc_tta_accordion][vc_custom_heading text=”Food, Drink and Shop” google_fonts=”font_family:Roboto%3A100%2C100italic%2C300%2C300italic%2Cregular%2Citalic%2C500%2C500italic%2C700%2C700italic%2C900%2C900italic|font_style:400%20regular%3A400%3Anormal”][vc_tta_accordion active_section=”” collapsible_all=”true”][vc_tta_section title=”Which food outlets will be open?” tab_id=”1593452300459-29f3034a-79a0″][vc_column_text]

  • Loves Grove Café, situated next to the Watercoasters.
  • Courtyard Café, situated at the Farm.
  • Chicken & Pizza Parlour, situated next to the Master Blaster.
  • Rays Diner, situated within the Empire of the Sea Dragon

Depending on seasonality and demand some cafés may be closed. Additional ice cream and drink kiosks will be open during appropriate weather.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”Can I bring a picnic?” tab_id=”1593452300657-8c6968b2-9e92″][vc_column_text]Yes of course! You will be able to enjoy our lovely grounds and find the perfect spot for a picnic. There are various picnic benches and seating areas located around the park appropriate for having a picnic, especially on a sunny day![/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”Can you cater for dietary requirements?” tab_id=”1593452300269-68911f6e-fb16″][vc_column_text]It’s important we know about your requirements before we prepare your food. Always make sure you tell our team about any dietary requirements before placing your order. We will be able to check which of our menu items meet your requirements.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”Is your gift shop open?” tab_id=”1593452499048-a2fe2099-98e1″][vc_column_text]Yes – with cuddly toys, pocket money items, and souvenirs, our gift shop is a great place to finish your visit!

At Teddy Mountain, inside the gift shop, you can build and dress your very own teddy to take home![/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”Can I pay by cash at your outlets?” tab_id=”1593452531998-fba40d58-3d0d”][vc_column_text]Yes – cash or card can be used at most facilities in the park.

Please note: ice cream kiosks are cash only. Cashback is available at Reception.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][/vc_tta_accordion][vc_custom_heading text=”The Rides” google_fonts=”font_family:Roboto%3A100%2C100italic%2C300%2C300italic%2Cregular%2Citalic%2C500%2C500italic%2C700%2C700italic%2C900%2C900italic|font_style:400%20regular%3A400%3Anormal”][vc_tta_accordion active_section=”” collapsible_all=”true”][vc_tta_section title=”Are there any age/height restrictions on the rides/attractions?” tab_id=”1463145217512-4b6d8292-b85f”][vc_column_text]Yes, as with all other Theme Parks there are height and age restrictions on the majority of the rides for Health and Safety reasons. Details can be found on our rides pages. Details are also clearly stated on the information boards at the rides and printed in our park guide. For a full height restrictions list please click here.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”Do any rides expose you to water?” tab_id=”1463145217719-7b675f6c-0256″][vc_column_text]Yes, the watercoasters and bumper boats are two areas where you are likely to get wet. We also have a small paddling pool which is open in the summer.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”Do any attractions involve you being in confined space?” tab_id=”1463145331619-cfe7f0d5-792f”][vc_column_text]Some of the rides and attractions can be quite small in area and to some individuals these may feel confined.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”Do any of the rides/attractions feature strobe lighting?” tab_id=”1463145365660-1cb64270-6bc1″][vc_column_text]Yes strobe lighting is used within the Seascape Mirror Maze. Some areas do feature Ultra-Violet (UV) flashing lights.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”Are the rides and attractions inspected on a daily basis?” tab_id=”1463145404089-79745658-ff85″][vc_column_text]All rides undergo a rigorous testing everyday by competent personnel in accordance with manufacturers guidance before the ride being opened to the public.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”If I am pregnant am I able to use the rides attractions?” tab_id=”1463145434398-c4fda1e1-eb65″][vc_column_text]We advise that you check the ride notices at each ride; however it is entirely at your own risk. In addition to the rides Woodlands has wonderful Woodlands walks, a fantastic collection of animals at Woodlands Zoo-Farm and Falconry Centre with displays that can be enjoyed.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”Are any rides/attractions closed at certain times of the year?” tab_id=”1463145463934-62a269c3-4017″][vc_column_text]In adverse weather conditions certain rides will not be run for safety reasons. The Toboggan Run and Jumping Pillow have to close when it is raining.

During the winter fun and offpeak term time seasons the following rides are closed: Watercoasters, Toboggan Run, Avalanche, Arctic Gliders, Dune Buggies, Pedal Boats, Farmyard Ride, Jumping Pillow and the Safari Adventure Golf.

During the winter not all attractions will have a Ride Operator.  If you would like to use a ride which is not closed for the winter please find a Ranger who will gladly open the ride for you.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”Can I go on rides with a cast?” tab_id=”1463145508349-f78bc420-ab12″][vc_column_text]A guest with a limb in a plaster cast may be permitted to use a ride as long as they are able to adequately restrain themselves in a manner determined by the ride in question. The Ride Operator will be able to offer advice and their decisions on whether the guest is able to use the ride is final.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][/vc_tta_accordion][vc_custom_heading text=”Other FAQs” google_fonts=”font_family:Roboto%3A100%2C100italic%2C300%2C300italic%2Cregular%2Citalic%2C500%2C500italic%2C700%2C700italic%2C900%2C900italic|font_style:400%20regular%3A400%3Anormal”][vc_tta_accordion active_section=”” collapsible_all=”true”][vc_tta_section title=”Other than the Rides and Attractions – what else does Woodlands have to offer?” tab_id=”1463146680403-ae5e9dd7-4146″][vc_column_text]Our Zoo-Farm is home to a wide range of animals, some you may recognise, others very exotic! Many of our zoo animals can be fed with feed available to buy on most days at the entrance kiosk.

In addition, guests can take a break from the rides by walking down into the valley and enjoying the beautiful natural scenery and ponds surrounding our pedal boats lake.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”Can I holiday at Woodlands?” tab_id=”1463146680667-b1a3c418-287d”][vc_column_text]We have our own 5 star standard and AA 5 pennant campsite here at Woodlands. Even better when you stay at Woodlands Grove Caravan and Camping Park, Woodlands Family Theme Park is included in your stay.

Visit our campsite website here[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”Looking to holiday in the area? Our Self-Catering recommendations” tab_id=”1463146858881-8df21aba-e3ba”][vc_column_text]Norton Park, Dartmouth tel: 01803 839500 (Chalets)

Hillfield Village, Hillfield, Dartmouth  01803 712322  (Cottages)

Or try the Dartmouth Tourist Information Centre on 01803 834224

You could also try www.southdevon.org.uk

We do hope you find somewhere to stay, the South Hams is such a beautiful area.

Perhaps you will be able to pay a day visit to Woodlands Leisure Park, open daily at 9.30am

see  www.woodlandspark.com for full info.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”What is the best way to get to Woodlands Park?” tab_id=”1463147027881-cebb5bbf-1a63″][vc_column_text]Details can be found on our Contact and Find us Page.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”Is there a car parking charge?” tab_id=”1463147081661-c2dd512f-d5fd”][vc_column_text]All car parking is free. There is ample parking for our guests. When arriving at the park please follow the signs and our car parking staff instructions to ensure cars are parked both quickly and safely.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”Is there electric vehicle charging?” tab_id=”1732534050158-6b5c3381-2da7″][vc_column_text css=””]Yes, EV chargers are located in the top day visitor’s car park. They are accessible via the Pod Point App.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”Do you make charitable donations?” tab_id=”1463147115400-3e885009-76aa”][vc_column_text]Details on our policy regarding our charitable donations can be found on our charity page.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”Are there any traffic hazards on site?” tab_id=”1463147192079-e2736f97-b09e”][vc_column_text]We keep vehicle traffic to a minimum whilst the Park is open to the public. There is a designated area for coaches in the car park.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”What is shadow payments?” tab_id=”1463147227374-e3b3a880-2490″][vc_column_text]When paying for an order, your bank will send us an authorisation code to confirm there are funds in the account. Your bank will then proceed to ‘shadow’ the value of your order (this means they reserve the funds so that they cannot be spent elsewhere). The bank does this in anticipation of receiving a successful status against the transaction. When the bank is advised the transaction has been successful and that the funds are to be processed, this will ensure the funds are allocated correctly. However, if the transaction is not successfully completed (e.g. if the payment is declined or rejected) then the funds will go back into your account. Occasionally the ‘shadow’ may remain on your account for between 3-6 days depending on your bank.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”Summary” tab_id=”1463147266871-1ef6e12e-2fb9″][vc_column_text]The quality and safety of all our rides and attractions are of the utmost importance. The staff at Woodlands Leisure Park are committed to ensuring that “our visitors are provided with a unique family experience that represents the best value for money day out in a safe and quality environment”.

Policies are subject to change without notice. Violating Woodlands rules may lead to ejection and prosecution to the limits of the law.

We trust this information answers your queries and ensures you that the highest safety standards are employed here.

If you require any further information please contact us via email and a Woodlands Representative will contact you asap. Email fun@woodlandspark.com[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][/vc_tta_accordion][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/2″][vc_custom_heading text=”Annual Passes” google_fonts=”font_family:Roboto%3A100%2C100italic%2C300%2C300italic%2Cregular%2Citalic%2C500%2C500italic%2C700%2C700italic%2C900%2C900italic|font_style:400%20regular%3A400%3Anormal”][vc_tta_accordion active_section=”” collapsible_all=”true”][vc_tta_section title=”What do I get with an Annual Pass?” tab_id=”1644225931765-add5bffe-250d”][vc_column_text]An Annual Pass to Woodlands includes unlimited visits to the park throughout the year. Benefit from access to our character days and special guest events, as well as discounted birthday parties!

Members not only get entry into Woodlands every open day for a year but they also get 10% off at our food outlets, 15% off gift shop purchases and 20% off caravan & camping stays.

For full info on our Annual Passes click the button below:[/vc_column_text][vc_btn title=”Annual Pass Information” style=”3d” shape=”round” color=”warning” size=”lg” align=”center” i_icon_fontawesome=”fas fa-question-circle” add_icon=”true” link=”url:https%3A%2F%2Fwww.woodlandspark.com%2Fyour-visit%2Finformation%2Fannual-pass%2F|target:_blank”][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”Annual Pass Form” tab_id=”1593452048643-370f0ad2-bc30″][vc_column_text css=””]On your first visit after buying an annual pass you will need to complete our annual pass form. We recommend printing off the form and completing it before your visit so we can get you set up and enjoying the park as quickly as possible.

If you do not have access to a printer, you can still complete this form at the entrance gate, however this will take a little longer.

If you can print the form, please download it from our Annual Pass page and don’t forget to bring it with you on your first visit.

Save time setting up your annual passes in person! Download and fill out your 2026 annual pass form here.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][/vc_tta_accordion][vc_custom_heading text=”Tickets and Season Passes” google_fonts=”font_family:Roboto%3A100%2C100italic%2C300%2C300italic%2Cregular%2Citalic%2C500%2C500italic%2C700%2C700italic%2C900%2C900italic|font_style:400%20regular%3A400%3Anormal”][vc_tta_accordion active_section=”” collapsible_all=”true”][vc_tta_section title=”What are the ticket options to gain entry to the park?” tab_id=”1463136471432-160855a2-b129″][vc_column_text]Tickets can either be purchased at the gate or via our online ticketing system.

Recommended: Tickets purchased online before the day of entry are 30% off!

Tickets purchased online on the day of entry are 10% off.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”How do I purchase discounted tickets online?” tab_id=”1463136471542-a009883c-9f33″][vc_column_text]To qualify for 30% off entry, tickets must be purchased in advance before the day you visit. Tickets will be automatically shown at the discounted price when purchasing in advance of your visit online.

Please note: up to 30% off discount tickets are only available during the Main Season & Summer Holiday seasons.

Tickets are dated tickets and are only valid on the date which is booked.

To change the date on your ticket: This needs to be done 24 hours before your visit and a £5 charge applies. You will need to call Woodlands Reception Team on 01803 712598 who will be able to change your ticket for a fee of £5 per booking number.

To buy your tickets please visit our online ticketing system.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”Do guests entering the park on a family ticket need to arrive at the same time?” tab_id=”1463137592363-503a5a3c-fb57″][vc_column_text]Yes, this is the same for online tickets and tickets bought on the gate. All members of the family must enter the Park at the same time.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”Do you provide concessionary tickets for group bookings?” tab_id=”1463137629458-a36dfb50-ea7d”][vc_column_text]Group tickets are available for 10 paying guests or more. If you would like to book a group in please call our reception team on 01803 712598.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”How can I purchase an Annual Pass?” tab_id=”1463137655807-b54fdb09-970f”][vc_column_text]Annual Passes can be purchased online. To learn more visit our Annual Passes information page here

Alternatively…

Annual Passes can be purchased at the park either before entry or by upgrading your day tickets to an annual pass during your visit. Renewals can be done at the Entrance Gate. For more information please see our Annual Pass page[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”Do you do Gift Vouchers?” tab_id=”1463137705941-dfda76d3-8a42″][vc_column_text]Give a unique and fun gift! Purchase your gift vouchers online. For more information please see our Gift Vouchers page.

Alternatively, visit our reception during your visit to purchase a gift voucher.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”Do you offer Blue Light or NHS discount?” tab_id=”1746612867685-d4101688-f68d”][vc_column_text css=””]We do not offer NHS or Blue Light Discount at this time.

Discounted ticket rates are available for guests with disabilities and senior citizens (60+).[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][/vc_tta_accordion][vc_custom_heading text=”Buying Online” google_fonts=”font_family:Roboto%3A100%2C100italic%2C300%2C300italic%2Cregular%2Citalic%2C500%2C500italic%2C700%2C700italic%2C900%2C900italic|font_style:400%20regular%3A400%3Anormal”][vc_tta_accordion active_section=”” collapsible_all=”true”][vc_tta_section title=”Do I need an email address?” tab_id=”1463138880873-cf145383-3b76″][vc_column_text]Yes, a valid email address is required so we can send you your order confirmation.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”Do I need a printer or smart phone?” tab_id=”1463138881028-210c09cd-1809″][vc_column_text]Tickets purchased online have a barcode on them or a confirmation number which we need access to when you arrive at the park.  Please note if you just bring your confirmation number photo ID will be required.

Having your barcode ready at the entrance gate will help us get you into the park as quickly as possible.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][/vc_tta_accordion][vc_custom_heading text=”Order Status” google_fonts=”font_family:Roboto%3A100%2C100italic%2C300%2C300italic%2Cregular%2Citalic%2C500%2C500italic%2C700%2C700italic%2C900%2C900italic|font_style:400%20regular%3A400%3Anormal”][vc_tta_accordion active_section=”” collapsible_all=”true”][vc_tta_section title=”I have not received an order confirmation email?” tab_id=”1463138996324-58358213-c9b8″][vc_column_text]Please call our reception team on 01803 712598 who can look into this for you.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”How do I check if my order has gone through?” tab_id=”1463138996485-be391d28-8592″][vc_column_text]If you experience an issue when purchasing your tickets i.e your internet connection drops or the payments page freezes. Please contact our reception team on 01803 712598 who will be able to tell you if the tickets have been purchased or if you need to rebook.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”I have purchased duplicate tickets what do I do?” tab_id=”1463139139317-38a8728c-a19d”][vc_column_text]Please call our reception team on 01803 712598 who can look into this for you.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”Do I need to bring my ticket order no or ID?” tab_id=”1463139167281-0c5c74f0-5558″][vc_column_text]Yes please bring your ticket order number when you arrive on the entrance kiosk. If you can bring your order confirmation email with the scannable barcode this is preferred.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][/vc_tta_accordion][vc_custom_heading text=”On the Day” google_fonts=”font_family:Roboto%3A100%2C100italic%2C300%2C300italic%2Cregular%2Citalic%2C500%2C500italic%2C700%2C700italic%2C900%2C900italic|font_style:400%20regular%3A400%3Anormal”][vc_tta_accordion active_section=”” collapsible_all=”true”][vc_tta_section title=”Can I use my Credit and/or Debit Card at the Park?” tab_id=”1463145568946-41b028bf-5e85″][vc_column_text]Yes we accept Debit and Credit Cards at our entrance kiosk, shops, Rays Diner, Chicken & Pizza Parlour and Loves Grove Cafe. A £5 minimum spend applies. Other catering outlets and ice cream kiosks are cash only.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”Can I obtain cash at the park ?” tab_id=”1463145569175-ed04bd4a-b14f”][vc_column_text]Yes please come to the reception building behind the main entrance for cashback.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”Does the park accept personal cheques?” tab_id=”1463145832600-91cb8045-e449″][vc_column_text]In line with the majority of other businesses the park does not accept personal cheques. Cheques drawn against a business account or group can be accepted but only by prior arrangement.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”Do you operate a fast track queuing system?” tab_id=”1463145868900-5776cc2b-2e49″][vc_column_text]No, we operate a traditional queuing system. Please respect fellow Woodlands guests by waiting your turn. Cutting in, line jumping or disruptive conduct is not permitted and may lead to you being asked to leave the park.  If you feel that your child may not be able to queue due to special circumstances please speak to the ride operator who will be able to assist you. For further information please call our reception team on 01803 722598.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”Is it easy to find our way around the Park?” tab_id=”1463145910511-d347e9db-2cef”][vc_column_text]Yes, to assist with this each group receives a Park Guide which includes a detailed map of the Park when they purchase their Admission Tickets. There are also numerous sign posts and maps around the park.
You can also scan our QR code on entry for a digital map.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”Do you hire wheelchairs and children’s buggies?” tab_id=”1463145940217-84335f12-9bcf”][vc_column_text]I’m afraid we do not hire wheelchairs or children’s buggies. We do recommend bringing buggies for children as unfortunately we cannot alter the location, Woodlands Family Theme Park is situated in a valley with steep hills; this can be difficult for wheelchair users, they would need a strong pusher.

If you wish to hire any scooters or wheelchairs this can be done with the following companies:

Wheelchair Hire St Johns: 01803 835818 or 07815 852737

Red Cross (Totnes): 01803 863563

Scooter Hire: New Ability (Paignton): 01803 555961[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”Do you allow smoking in the park?” tab_id=”1463145974270-1a95c819-4dbd”][vc_column_text]Our Park is a no smoking/vaping park. No smoking/vaping is allowed on any attraction, ride, gift shop and queue or inside any building. For cigarette ends please dispose of them in the receptacles provided. Please smoke/vape in the designated areas only, located at the Sea Monster Zone.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”Does the park operate a dress code?” tab_id=”1463146012606-4948bcbf-e8ad”][vc_column_text]Yes, in line with our family image gentlemen are requested to wear a T-Shirt or similar at all times.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”What are the medical provisions on site?” tab_id=”1463146060446-9b240179-b018″][vc_column_text]The park has a First Aid Centre which is located on the patio opposite Reception, there is a bell to ring to call for a First Aider. Qualified First Aiders are also available in the Park to deal with minor injuries.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”What happens if I lose a child?” tab_id=”1463146104435-f6f93e07-9ba9″][vc_column_text]The park has a comprehensive and well proven lost child procedure of which all our staff are trained to follow. It is a good idea to make a pre-arranged meeting place.

In the event of a lost child please notify a staff member in the area the child went missing. You can also report lost children to Reception who will have contact with other members of staff around the park. Reception is the point of contact where lost children will stay. We advice that you set up a place in the park where a member of staff will be.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”Are there any steep slopes on the site?” tab_id=”1463146181828-260375fe-7048″][vc_column_text]Woodlands is situated in a valley so many of the paths are on steep slopes. Wheelchair users will need a strong pusher and please note some electric wheelchairs cannot cope with the incline.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”Baby changing facilities?” tab_id=”1463146212578-74214133-10ad”][vc_column_text]There are baby changing facilities in the park which are located on the Park Guide. A microwave is available for heating food in the Empire of the Sea Dragon on the café level.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”Do you allow dogs or pets in the park?” tab_id=”1463146266088-df3ca5b2-aa0c”][vc_column_text css=””]Pets are not permitted in the theme park with the exception of Assistance dogs. Unsupervised, free kennels are available on a first come first served basis and are non-bookable.  Woodlands is not responsible for the feeding, watering, cleaning or welfare of your pet.  Please make sure the kennel is left clean and tidy. Just take £25 to the entrance kiosk on arrival as the deposit for the padlock; the £25 is refunded when the padlock is returned. You will need to bring your own water bowl and blanket/bed, there is a tap at the kennels to fill your bowl.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”What catering facilities are there at the park?” tab_id=”1463146389535-00e2eb07-45b2″][vc_column_text]Please visit our Food and drink section to find out more.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”Are we able to bring a picnic?” tab_id=”1463146452241-9cdfc91a-13f2″][vc_column_text]Guests are welcome to bring their own picnic and there are picnic areas around the park where these can be enjoyed.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”Are there lockers within the park?” tab_id=”1463146485512-b281ed85-1f7e”][vc_column_text]Lockers can be found in the Empire of the Sea Dragon, Circus Drome and upstairs in Lovesgrove café. These are fully secured with a key and are charged at 20p per use. No loose articles are permitted on the rides and slides.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”Is there lots to do when it’s raining?” tab_id=”1463146518500-f4728e31-8512″][vc_column_text]There is plenty to do when it is raining! We have the largest indoor play area in the South West with over 120,000sq ft of indoor play. In this one building there is 5 floors of indoor action with fairground style rides like Trauma Tower and The Submarine Ride, as well as a huge soft play area with a separate dedicated play area for little ones. We have the Circus Drome Play Zone, Falconry Centre and the majority of the buildings in the Zoo-Farm are all undercover. Both our Swing Ship and Vertigo outdoor rides can operate in most weather conditions and during the summer our water rides can remain open unless for extreme weather.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”Can I exit the park to collect belongings from the car?” tab_id=”1463146578708-aff7bb8b-934d”][vc_column_text]Absolutely, by obtaining a Hand Stamp at the Entrance Kiosks, it allows guests to exit the Park to collect and return belongings from and to their car whenever they wish.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][/vc_tta_accordion][vc_custom_heading text=”Group Visits” google_fonts=”font_family:Roboto%3A100%2C100italic%2C300%2C300italic%2Cregular%2Citalic%2C500%2C500italic%2C700%2C700italic%2C900%2C900italic|font_style:400%20regular%3A400%3Anormal”][vc_tta_accordion active_section=”” collapsible_all=”true”][vc_tta_section title=”How many people do I need to qualify for group rates?” tab_id=”1463144473835-f7ded30f-0769″][vc_column_text]For Family Groups: 20 or more paying people. If you have less than 20 paying customers, the standard admission rates will apply.
For Organisational Groups: 10 or more paying people. If you have less than 10 paying customers the standard admission rates will apply. Please speak to our Reception team for more details on Organisation Groups.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”Do groups members need to arrive together?” tab_id=”1463144474017-48fc19ed-c5f7″][vc_column_text]Yes the group must enter the park altogether.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”Do I need to book?” tab_id=”1463144591000-e30db023-8269″][vc_column_text]Yes, please make sure group bookings are booked in at least 24 hours before your visit by calling 01803 712598.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”Do you give Free concessions to group organisers?” tab_id=”1463144626567-053f518a-e8b6″][vc_column_text]We offer generous Free Leaders ratios, variable according to the age group of the children in the party, to ensure adequate supervision. The adults with children under the age of 17 are responsible for them at all times, so must be with the group throughout the visit.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”When do I pay?” tab_id=”1463144665882-2d506830-ee73″][vc_column_text]Payment for groups must be made on arrival to the admission kiosks.

To qualify for the group rates prices, this must be pre-booked over the phone and to speed up entry please let us know the number of adults, children over 110cms, adventurers 92cms-110cms and infants under 92cm before you come.

For any other enquiries regarding paying for your group visit please call our reception team on 01803 712598.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”Do I pay a deposit?” tab_id=”1463144697717-229865cf-e51e”][vc_column_text]Group visits require a £75 non refundable deposit payment to secure.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”How do I pay?” tab_id=”1463144748667-d27ea6f6-c020″][vc_column_text]Payment can be made by credit/debit card (not American Express) or by cash. Payment is required on the day of the visit. Please note we do not accept personal cheques. We do accept group company cheques but this must be arranged prior to the group arriving.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”Do you have coach parking?” tab_id=”1463144866274-2a1fdb10-0951″][vc_column_text]We do have free coach parking in the lower car park. Coach drivers are given free admission to the park.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”Can I buy tickets before the day?” tab_id=”1463144910690-08e41353-4a3d”][vc_column_text]We are able to provide pre paid tickets as long as it is done at least two weeks in advance. Payment must be taken at the time of booking and tickets will be sent out to the group organiser to distribute. Pre paid tickets will be date specific and please note there are no refunds or date changes on pre-paid tickets.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”Can we arrive in separate cars?” tab_id=”1463144953006-382a719d-47b8″][vc_column_text]Yes we have plenty of free car parking. You will need to arrange to meet in the car park and go to the admission kiosks together and pay in one transaction.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”Can we go back to the coach or cars?” tab_id=”1463144986865-f0377a81-85fc”][vc_column_text]Yes you just need to visit the admission kiosks on the way out and get your hand stamped.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”Are there any toilets in the car park?” tab_id=”1463145015750-c58e6691-c383″][vc_column_text]Yes we have toilets in the lower car park.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”In the event that children misbehave – disciplinary action?” tab_id=”1463145049314-3d9f0bd9-bf03″][vc_column_text]The Park has regulations displayed on boards around the Park. Staff are trained to enforce these regulations. Staff will instruct children/adults to behave where necessary, particularly if safety is compromised.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”What should I do if I lose a child?” tab_id=”1463145087915-ab9e67c5-6dee”][vc_column_text]The park has a comprehensive and well proven lost child procedure of which all our staff are trained to follow. It is a good idea to make a pre-arranged meeting place.

In the event of a lost child please notify a staff member in the area the child went missing. You can also report lost children to Reception who will have contact with other members of staff around the park. Reception is the point of contact where lost children will stay. We advice that you set up a place in the park where a member of staff will be.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][/vc_tta_accordion][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_column_text]

Have a question that hasn’t been answered?

Please email us on fun@woodlandspark.com to ensure your query is logged and replied to. During periods of high enquiries our reply times may be slower, we apologise in advance and will see to your query as soon as possible.

[/vc_column_text][vc_raw_js][/vc_raw_js][/vc_column][vc_column][/vc_column][/vc_row]
